about.meta_description: Learn about PickMyTrade - the trading automation platform trusted by 50,000+ traders worldwide.
about.hero_subtitle: We built PickMyTrade to bridge the gap between TradingView strategies and live trading execution. No coding required, under-200ms order processing on our side, and support for 9+ prop firms.
about.story_p1: PickMyTrade was born out of a simple frustration: talented traders with winning TradingView strategies had no reliable, affordable way to execute them automatically on Tradovate and prop firm accounts.
about.story_p2: Existing solutions were either too expensive, too complex, or didn't support the prop firms that traders actually used. We set out to build a platform that anyone could use — from a first-time prop firm trader to a seasoned algo developer running strategies across dozens of accounts.
about.story_p3: Today, PickMyTrade processes millions of automated trades for thousands of traders worldwide. We support 9+ prop firms, offer multi-account trade copying, and provide enterprise-grade reliability at just $50/month.
about.feature_execution_desc: PickMyTrade processes your order in under 200ms on our side, once your TradingView alert arrives. No manual intervention needed.
about.feature_security_desc: OAuth 2.0 authentication, AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging, and access controls modeled on SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria.
about.feature_community_desc: Built with direct feedback from our 50,000+ trader community. Features shaped by the people who use them.
about.founder_section_title: Built by a Trader, for Traders
about.founder_section_subtitle: PickMyTrade is built and maintained by a small, focused team led by its founder.
about.founder_p1: PickMyTrade was founded after personally hitting the same wall every retail futures trader hits: a winning TradingView strategy, real capital on Tradovate or a prop firm account, and no affordable, reliable way to get the two to talk.
about.founder_p2: He builds and operates PickMyTrade's webhook execution layer end-to-end: the JSON payload parser, the OAuth bridges into Tradovate and Interactive Brokers, the Rithmic R|API session handling, the multi-account copy engine, and the bracket/SL/TP logic that respects each prop firm's rule set. The result is a TradingView-to-broker bridge that processes orders in under 200ms on our side, at $50/month flat, used by 50,000+ traders to execute over 5M trades.
about.founder_contact_post: for engineering, partnership, or media inquiries.
about.mission_subtitle: We believe every trader — regardless of technical skill — should have access to professional-grade automation tools. Our mission is to make TradingView strategy execution as simple as clicking a button.
about.mission_no_code_desc: Connect your TradingView alerts to your broker in minutes. Our platform handles the complexity so you can focus on your strategy.
about.mission_affordable_desc: One flat price of $50/month with unlimited trades and unlimited sub-accounts under one broker login. No hidden fees, no per-trade charges, and a free 7-day trial.
about.mission_support_desc: Our support team and active Discord community are always available. Email support with 24-hour response time, plus real-time community help.
about.platform_subtitle: Our platform integrates with the tools and firms traders rely on every day.
about.cta_subtitle: Join 50,000+ traders who trust PickMyTrade for their automated futures trading. Start your free 7-day trial today.

privacy.notice_text: PLEASE READ THIS PRIVACY POLICY CAREFULLY TO UNDERSTAND HOW WE TREAT YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION AND WHAT CHOICES AND RIGHTS YOU HAVE IN THIS REGARD. IF YOU DO NOT AGREE WITH THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THIS POLICY, YOU SHOULD NOT ACCESS OR USE THE SITE.
privacy.section_intro_p1: PickMyTrade Pvt. Ltd. ("PickMyTrade," "we," "our," or "us") values your privacy and is committed to safeguarding your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of personal data we collect, how we use and share that information, and your choices and rights related to your personal data.
privacy.section_intro_p2: Please take the time to read this Privacy Policy carefully. By accessing or using our website, PickMyTrade.trade (the "Site"), or any of our services, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, you should discontinue using the Site immediately.
privacy.section_when_p1: This Privacy Policy applies to your interactions with the Site and any information collected online. It does not apply to offline activities or any third-party websites you may access through links on the Site. By using the Site, you agree to the collection, use, and sharing of your personal information as described here. Please review the Terms of Service, which govern the use of the Site and this Privacy Policy.
privacy.section_eu_p1: If you are located in the European Union ("EU") or the European Economic Area ("EEA"), special provisions outlined in the sections titled "Rights of EU/EEA Residents" and "International Data Transfers" may apply to you. These provisions comply with the EU's General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR") and offer additional rights and protections regarding the collection and processing of personal information.
privacy.section_collect_what_title: What Personal Information Do We Collect?
privacy.section_collect_what_intro: We collect various types of personal information when you interact with the Site. The categories of personal data we may collect include:
privacy.collect_contact_info: Contact Information: Name, email address, postal address, telephone number, or other similar contact details.
privacy.collect_account_info: Account Information: Username, password, security questions, and related authentication details.
privacy.collect_transaction_data: Transaction Data: Details about services you have subscribed to or purchased, such as subscription history and billing details.
privacy.collect_technical_data: Technical Data: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, and device identifiers.
privacy.collect_usage_data: Usage Data: Information about your browsing activity, interactions with the Site, and the resources accessed.
privacy.collect_marketing_prefs: Marketing Preferences: Your preferences in receiving marketing and communications from us.
privacy.collect_broker_data: Broker Connection Data: OAuth tokens and account identifiers used to connect your brokerage accounts (e.g., Tradovate, Rithmic, Interactive Brokers). We do not store your broker passwords — authentication is handled via OAuth 2.0 or secure API key connections.
privacy.collect_trading_data: Trading Activity Data: Records of automated trades executed through our platform, including order types, timestamps, symbols, quantities, and execution status. This data is used to provide the service and is accessible in your account dashboard.
privacy.collect_sensitive_info: Sensitive Information: We do not collect any special categories of personal information, such as health data or biometric data, unless required by law and only with your explicit consent.
privacy.section_how_collect_title: How Do We Collect Your Information?
privacy.section_how_collect_direct_intro: We collect personal data directly from you when you:
privacy.how_collect_direct_1: Register an account on our platform
privacy.how_collect_direct_2: Subscribe to our services or purchase a product
privacy.how_collect_direct_3: Contact us for support or inquiries
privacy.how_collect_direct_5: Interact with our email campaigns and newsletters
privacy.section_how_collect_auto_intro: We may also collect information through automated technologies, such as:
privacy.how_collect_cookies: Cookies: These are small text files stored on your browser or device that help us track your activity on the Site. You can control cookies through your browser settings.
privacy.how_collect_web_beacons: Web Beacons: Invisible image files used to understand your interaction with our emails or web pages.
privacy.how_collect_social_widgets: Social Media Widgets: Features that allow you to share content on social media, which may collect your browsing data.
privacy.how_collect_analytics: Analytics Tools: We use third-party analytics tools like Google Analytics to gather data about how users engage with our Site.
privacy.section_required_title: Is Entry of Personal Information Required?
privacy.section_required_p1: You can browse certain parts of the Site without providing personal information. However, some sections of the Site, including account registration, subscribing to services, or making purchases, require personal information. Without this information, we may be unable to provide you with full access to our services.
privacy.section_use_title: How Do We Use Your Personal Information?
privacy.section_use_intro: We process your personal information for the following purposes:
privacy.use_service_provision: Service Provision: To create and maintain your account, manage subscriptions, process transactions, and deliver services.
privacy.use_customer_support: Customer Support: To provide technical support, answer questions, and address any issues related to your account or our services.
privacy.use_personalization: Personalization: To tailor our services and communications based on your preferences and usage of the Site.
privacy.use_marketing: Marketing: To send promotional content, newsletters, and special offers, subject to your preferences. You may opt out of marketing communications at any time.
privacy.use_legal_compliance: Legal Compliance: To comply with legal obligations, such as tax reporting or responding to legal requests.
privacy.use_security: Security: To protect our Site, systems, and users from potential risks, fraud, and malicious activity.
privacy.section_use_additional: In addition to the above, we may process your personal data when necessary to meet legal obligations or exercise legal rights, to manage risks and obtain legal or professional advice, and to generate and use aggregated or de-identified data for analytics and research purposes.
privacy.section_legal_basis_title: Legal Basis for Processing Your Information
privacy.section_legal_basis_intro: For EU/EEA residents, we process your personal information on the following legal grounds:
privacy.legal_basis_contractual: Contractual Necessity: When processing is necessary to provide services you have requested, such as managing your account or processing transactions.
privacy.legal_basis_legitimate: Legitimate Interests: For purposes such as security, fraud prevention, or marketing, provided your rights and interests do not override these purposes.
privacy.legal_basis_consent: Consent: When you have given explicit consent, such as when you opt in to receive marketing emails.
privacy.legal_basis_compliance: Legal Compliance: When processing is necessary to comply with legal obligations.
privacy.section_cookies_p1: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect information about your browsing habits. These technologies help us understand how users interact with our Site and improve the user experience.
privacy.cookies_session: Session Cookies: Temporary cookies that are deleted when you close your browser.
privacy.cookies_persistent: Persistent Cookies: Remain on your device until they expire or you delete them.
privacy.cookies_first_party: First-Party Cookies: Set by PickMyTrade to enhance your experience on the Site.
privacy.cookies_third_party: Third-Party Cookies: Set by service providers (such as Google) to track user behavior across websites for marketing and analytics purposes.
privacy.section_cookies_control: You can control cookie settings through your browser or by using the cookie consent banner on our Site. However, disabling cookies may limit the functionality of certain features on the Site.
privacy.section_share_title: How Do We Share Your Information?
privacy.section_share_intro: We do not sell or rent your personal information. However, we may share your information in the following contexts:
privacy.share_corporate_affiliates: Corporate Affiliates: We may share your information with our affiliates and subsidiaries to provide services or for internal business purposes.
privacy.share_service_providers: Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing, marketing, customer support, and IT services.
privacy.share_legal_obligations: Legal Obligations: We may disclose your information to law enforcement, government agencies, or other parties as required by law or to protect our legal rights.
privacy.share_corporate_transactions: Corporate Transactions: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.
privacy.share_with_consent: With Your Consent: We may share your information with third parties not listed here with your explicit consent.
privacy.section_third_party_intro: Our platform connects to third-party services to provide automated trading functionality. When you use these integrations, the respective third party's privacy policy also applies:
privacy.third_party_brokerage: Brokerage Platforms: Tradovate, Rithmic, Interactive Brokers, TradeLocker, TradeStation, ProjectX, Matchtrader, Tradier (Beta), cTrader (Beta) and Ironbeam (Beta). privacy.third_party_payment: Payment Processors: We use third-party payment processors to handle subscription billing. Your full payment card details are processed and stored by these processors, not by PickMyTrade.
privacy.third_party_analytics: Analytics Services: We use Google Analytics and similar tools to understand how users interact with our Site. These services may set their own cookies and collect data as described in their respective privacy policies.
privacy.third_party_communication: Communication Platforms: We maintain a Discord community for user support. Your interactions on Discord are governed by Discord's privacy policy.
privacy.section_retention_p1: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy, or as required by law. Once your data is no longer needed, we will securely delete or anonymize it. However, some data may remain in backups or archived copies for legal compliance or to resolve disputes.
privacy.section_protection_title: How Do We Protect Your Information?
privacy.section_protection_p1: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure. While no system can guarantee absolute security, we strive to safeguard your information using industry-standard practices. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and promptly notifying us if you suspect any unauthorized use.
privacy.section_rights_title: Your Rights Regarding Your Personal Information
privacy.section_rights_intro: You have certain rights regarding your personal data. Depending on your location, these rights may include:
privacy.rights_access: Right to Access: Request access to the personal data we hold about you.

security.meta_description: PickMyTrade security practices - How we keep your trading data safe and secure.
security.hero_subtitle: Enterprise-grade security measures protect your trading accounts and data. We never store your credentials.
security.features_subtitle: Multiple layers of security protect your trading accounts.
security.feature_oauth_desc: Connect to Tradovate using industry-standard OAuth. We never see or store your login credentials.
security.feature_ssl_desc: All data transmitted between your browser and our servers is encrypted with bank-level security.
security.feature_no_withdrawal_desc: Our API connection only allows trade execution. We cannot withdraw funds or transfer money.
security.feature_cloud_desc: Hosted on enterprise-grade cloud servers with automatic failover and DDoS protection.
security.feature_firewall_desc: Web application firewall blocks malicious traffic and protects against common attack vectors.
security.feature_audit_desc: Complete activity logs track all actions for transparency and security monitoring.
security.oauth_p1: When you connect your Tradovate account, you're redirected to Tradovate's official login page. After you authenticate, Tradovate sends us a secure token that allows trade execution only.
security.oauth_p2_post: The authentication happens entirely on Tradovate's secure servers.
security.store_li1: Your email address for account access
security.faq_1_q: Can PickMyTrade withdraw money from my account?
security.faq_1_a: No. Our API connection only allows trade execution. We cannot initiate withdrawals, transfers, or access any banking functions.
security.faq_2_q: What happens if I want to disconnect my account?
security.faq_2_a: You can disconnect anytime from your PickMyTrade dashboard or revoke access directly from your Tradovate account settings. The OAuth token becomes invalid immediately.
security.faq_3_q: Is my trading strategy visible to PickMyTrade?
security.faq_3_a: We only see the alert messages you send (ticker, action, quantity). Your Pine Script source code and strategy logic remain private on TradingView.
security.faq_4_a: All data is encrypted in transit (SSL/TLS) and at rest (AES-256). We follow industry best practices for data security and access control.
security.cta_subtitle: Join 50,000+ traders who trust PickMyTrade with their automated trading.

use_cases.multi_account_faq_1_q: How many accounts can I copy to?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_1_a: Unlimited. There's no per-account fee or limit. You can copy trades to unlimited accounts under the same broker login with a single subscription. If you use multiple broker logins (even with the same prop firm or broker), each login requires a separate subscription.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_2_q: What if Manual Trade Copier isn't copying?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_2_a: Check: 1) Button must say “Click to Stop” (copier active), 2) Destination accounts must be enabled in list, 3) Source account has an open position to copy.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_3_q: Are trades executed simultaneously across all accounts?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_3_a: PickMyTrade processes the copy in under 200ms on our side and sends it to every connected account at once. Total fill time at each account also depends on that account's broker and network conditions, so very large account counts can see fills land a moment apart rather than at the identical instant.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_4_q: Can I pause copying to one account?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_4_a: Yes. You can enable/disable individual destination accounts in the copier without affecting others. Useful for temporary pauses.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_5_q: Does PickMyTrade work across different brokers at once?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_5_a: Yes. PickMyTrade connects to Tradovate, Rithmic, Interactive Brokers, TradeStation, TradeLocker, ProjectX, Match-Trader, Tradier (Beta), cTrader (Beta) and Ironbeam (Beta). Each broker connection is configured and subscribed separately, and one TradingView alert can still fire to all of your connected accounts across every broker you have set up.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_6_q: How much does multi-account copying cost?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_6_a: $50/month or $500/year per broker login, with a 7-day free trial and no credit card required. There is no extra per-account fee: unlimited accounts under one broker login are included.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_7_q: How fast does a trade copy to all my accounts?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_7_a: PickMyTrade processes your order in under 200ms on our side. Total time to each account also depends on that account's broker and network, so with a very large account count, some accounts may fill a moment apart from others.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_8_q: Can prop-firm accounts be part of my multi-account setup?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_8_a: Yes, as long as the prop firm's account runs on a broker PickMyTrade supports. Prop firms set their own rules on copy trading and automation, and those rules vary and change, so confirm your specific firm's current policy before connecting a funded account.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_9_q: What is the difference between the Manual Trade Copier and TradingView webhook copying?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_9_a: The Manual Trade Copier mirrors a trade you place by hand on a source account to your other connected accounts. Webhook copying instead triggers off a TradingView alert. You can use either method, or both together, depending on how you generate your signals.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_10_q: Can I use different quantity multipliers per account?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_10_a: Yes. Each connected account gets its own multiplier, so a signal sized for your main account can be scaled up or down automatically for every other account in the copy group.
use_cases.multi_account_faq_11_q: What happens if one account in my copy group has an issue?
use_cases.multi_account_faq_11_a: You can pause or disable any single client account without affecting the others. A rejected or failed order on one account does not block copying to the rest of the group.
use_cases.multi_account_pricing_p: PickMyTrade is $50/month or $500/year per broker login, with a 7-day free trial and no credit card required. Unlimited accounts under one broker login are included at no extra per-account fee; connecting an additional broker login is a separate subscription.

use_cases.pinescript_faq_1_q: Do I need to modify my Pine Script code?
use_cases.pinescript_faq_1_a: Not necessarily. If your strategy generates alerts, it should work. You may want to add plot() calls to expose dynamic TP/SL values, but the core strategy logic stays the same.
use_cases.pinescript_faq_2_q: Can I backtest before going live?
use_cases.pinescript_faq_2_a: Yes! Use TradingView's Strategy Tester for backtesting. Then connect to PickMyTrade with a demo account first. Once confident, switch to live.
use_cases.pinescript_faq_3_q: How do I handle contract rollovers?
use_cases.pinescript_faq_3_a: PickMyTrade handles contract rollover automatically. Use the base symbol (ES, NQ) and we map to the active front-month contract.
use_cases.pinescript_faq_4_q: Can I deploy to multiple accounts?
use_cases.pinescript_faq_4_a: Absolutely. Configure Manual Trade Copier to replicate signals across unlimited accounts with custom quantity multipliers per account.

automation.apex_unique_subtitle: Verified facts about Apex's 4.0 rule set (effective March 1, 2026) — profit splits, drawdown mechanics, payout structure, and automation policy — so you know exactly what you're building around before you connect PickMyTrade.
automation.apex_unique_fact1_desc: 100% of your first $25,000 in lifetime profit per Performance Account, then a 90/10 split above that threshold — unchanged under the Apex 4.0 rule set that took effect March 1, 2026. The $25K threshold applies per account, not pooled across every Performance Account you run.
automation.apex_unique_fact2_desc: Choose Intraday trailing drawdown ($79 activation), which tracks every unrealized tick, or End-of-Day trailing drawdown ($99 activation), which only moves the floor at each day's close — friendlier for TradingView strategies that hold positions through the session. As of 2026, trailing amounts scale with account size, roughly $1,000 on a $25K account up to $4,000 on a $150K account, and lock permanently once your balance clears starting balance plus drawdown plus $100.
automation.apex_unique_fact3_desc: Run up to 20 Performance Accounts per trader — as much as roughly $6M in combined funded buying power. PickMyTrade broadcasts one TradingView alert across every Apex account you've connected in the same pass, so you're not re-entering the same trade by hand 20 times.
automation.apex_unique_fact4_desc: Apex 4.0 still permits semi-automated trading — a supervised TradingView alert routed through a webhook bridge like PickMyTrade qualifies — but bans fully unattended, 24/7 unsupervised bots and rented or commercial EAs. Since March 2026, Apex also enforces bracket orders at the platform level: every order needs an attached stop-loss and take-profit or Tradovate/Rithmic rejects it outright, which is exactly what PickMyTrade's built-in SL/TP fields are built to satisfy.
automation.apex_unique_fact5_desc: Your first payout unlocks after 5 qualifying trading days — no deadline, and the days don't have to be consecutive — with a $500 minimum request. Each Performance Account gets a maximum of 6 approved payouts on a rising cap ladder before that account closes and you'd need to requalify through a fresh evaluation, so plan your automated strategy's pace around that lifecycle, not just the drawdown.
automation.apex_unique_fact6_desc: Apex's March 2026 relaunch replaced the old monthly-subscription evaluation with a one-time fee, relaxed the consistency rule from 30% to 50% of cumulative profit in a single day, and dropped the old MAE and 5:1 risk-reward rules along with the evaluation's minimum trading-day requirement. For an automated strategy, the 50% rule is the one to watch: keep your position sizing steady so no single alert-driven day outruns half your profit since your last payout.
automation.apex_unique_pmt_h3: Connecting Apex Trader Funding to PickMyTrade
automation.apex_unique_pmt_p: Connecting Apex takes minutes on either platform it supports. Tradovate-based Performance Accounts connect at pickmytrade.trade; Rithmic-based accounts use pickmytrade.io. One thing to check before you connect anything: Apex's Manual Order Submission Requirement restricts bots, scripts, and preset systems from placing, modifying, or cancelling orders on a Performance Account — a TradingView alert routed straight through a webhook has no manual click at the point of execution, so read Apex's current User Agreement or ask Apex support before relying on that shape. PickMyTrade's Manual Trade Copier is built differently and fits Apex's copy-trading carve-out: you place one order yourself in an account you're actively trading, and PickMyTrade mirrors it — with a stop-loss and take-profit attached automatically, satisfying Apex's March 2026 mandatory bracket-order rule — to the other Apex accounts you connect, up to the 20-account cap. Because Apex tracks the $25K lifetime-profit threshold and the 50% consistency rule per account rather than pooled, each connected account keeps its own math inside your PickMyTrade dashboard so you can see exactly where every account stands.
automation.apex_faq_h2: Frequently Asked Questions About Automating Apex Trader Funding
automation.apex_faq_1_q: Does Apex Trader Funding allow TradingView automation and webhook-based trading on Performance Accounts?
automation.apex_faq_1_a: That's Apex's call, not ours. Apex's User Agreement includes a Manual Order Submission Requirement: each order must be manually entered and confirmed by you, and pre-configured bots, scripts, or systems that place, modify, or cancel orders from preset conditions or signals are prohibited on Performance Accounts. Being able to watch and pause a strategy doesn't change that — a TradingView alert routed through a webhook bridge like PickMyTrade still places the order with no manual click at the point of execution, so it doesn't fit the narrow carve-outs Apex lists (alert-only tools that don't place orders, stop-loss/take-profit configured manually at entry, and copy trading from an account you're manually trading in real time). Read Apex's current User Agreement yourself, or ask Apex support, before connecting a Performance Account to any automation tool, including ours. PickMyTrade's Manual Trade Copier — where you place one order yourself and it mirrors to the other Apex accounts you connect — is built for that copy-trading carve-out instead.
automation.apex_faq_2_q: What changed in the Apex 4.0 update that automated traders on Tradovate need to know about?
automation.apex_faq_2_a: Apex 4.0 launched March 1, 2026 and replaced the old monthly-subscription evaluation with a one-time fee, added a choice between Intraday and End-of-Day trailing drawdown, relaxed the consistency rule from 30% to 50%, dropped the old MAE and 5:1 risk-reward rules, and removed the evaluation's minimum trading-day requirement. Most relevant for webhook trading: every order now needs an attached stop-loss and take-profit, and Tradovate and Rithmic reject unbracketed orders at submission.
automation.apex_faq_3_q: How does Apex's 50% consistency rule affect an automated TradingView strategy?
automation.apex_faq_3_a: At payout time, no single trading day can account for more than 50% of your total profit since your last payout. Because TradingView alerts fire on your strategy's rules rather than in-the-moment discretion, one strong signal can occasionally produce an outsized day. Keeping position sizing consistent across your alerts — PickMyTrade's fixed-quantity or risk-percentage sizing both work — helps stop one big session from pushing you over the 50% threshold and delaying a payout.
automation.apex_faq_4_q: How do payouts work on an Apex Performance Account traded through PickMyTrade?
automation.apex_faq_4_a: You become payout-eligible after 5 qualifying trading days (no deadline, and the days don't need to be consecutive), with a $500 minimum payout request. Each Performance Account is capped at 6 approved payouts on a rising ladder before that account closes and you'd need to pass a new evaluation. PickMyTrade doesn't touch your Apex payout process — it only automates order execution — but its alert log gives you a day-by-day trail you can use to confirm your qualifying days and consistency-rule math before you request a withdrawal.
automation.apex_faq_5_q: What do traders generally say about running automated or copy-trading strategies on Apex Trader Funding?
automation.apex_faq_5_a: Sentiment is mixed but has improved since the March 2026 overhaul. On forums like r/FuturesTrading, r/Daytrading, and futures.io, traders who automate through TradingView webhooks generally report that Apex's rules are easier to plan around once you account for the trailing drawdown and the per-order bracket requirement, and that automated payout processing — replacing the old manual review — resolved a lot of the withdrawal-delay complaints tied to earlier rule sets. The more persistent criticism centers on trailing-drawdown accounts getting caught by fast, volatile single-tick moves and on traders who feel frequent rule changes make it hard to plan a strategy long term — one more reason to build in the stop-loss/take-profit discipline Apex now requires on every order.
automation.myfunded_unique_subtitle: MFFU is one of the only major futures prop firms that explicitly permits TradingView-webhook automation and same-direction copy trading — here's what its 2026 rulebook actually says about plans, payouts, drawdown, and automation, cross-checked against MFFU's own help center.
automation.myfunded_unique_fact1_desc: As of 2026, MFFU runs a one-step, no-time-limit evaluation across five tiers: Core ($50K only, 80/20 split, 3% EOD trailing drawdown), Rapid ($50K–$150K, 90/10 split — raised in a January 2026 update, one of the richest splits in the industry — 4% intraday trailing drawdown), Pro ($50K–$150K, 80/20 split, 3% EOD trailing drawdown, 14-day payout cycle), plus lower-cost Flex and Builder entry tiers. Every plan needs just 2 minimum trading days to pass.
automation.myfunded_unique_fact2_desc: Minimum withdrawal differs by plan — $250 on Flex, $500 on Rapid and Builder, $1,000 on Pro — with cadence ranging from roughly every 5 winning days up to Pro's 14-calendar-day cycle. Approved payouts route through Riseworks via ACH bank transfer or crypto and typically clear in about 6–12 business hours, one of the faster payout pipelines among futures prop firms.
automation.myfunded_unique_fact3_desc: MFFU explicitly permits semi-automated trading, EAs, and TradingView-webhook tools like PickMyTrade across every plan, plus same-direction copy trading between your own accounts — as long as you actively monitor the strategy. Fully autonomous, unsupervised bots and any system firing more than 200 trades a day are still banned.
automation.myfunded_unique_fact4_desc: MFFU markets itself as one of the only firms crediting a free evaluation reset at every monthly subscription renewal — win, lose, or already breached — so one blown attempt doesn't automatically mean paying for a brand-new evaluation.
automation.myfunded_unique_fact5_h3: The Consistency Rule Is a Look-Back, Not a Cap
automation.myfunded_unique_fact5_desc: Rapid, Flex, and Pro evaluations use a 50% consistency rule — no single day can be more than half of your total evaluation profit — but it's only checked when you request a pass, and breaching it just means trading more days, not losing the account. Core drops the rule once funded but caps any single funded payout day at 40% of that cycle's profit. Neither rule limits how PickMyTrade sizes or times your automated entries.
automation.myfunded_unique_fact6_h3: One of the Highest-Rated Firms on Trustpilot
automation.myfunded_unique_fact6_desc: MFFU has held a Trustpilot score around 4.9 out of 5 from tens of thousands of reviews as of 2026, among the highest of any futures prop firm. Forum sentiment tends to praise responsive support and the free reset policy, while the recurring complaint is strict enforcement of drawdown and consistency rules — a trade-off traders generally weigh against MFFU's above-market profit splits.
automation.myfunded_unique_pmt_h3: Setting Up My Funded Futures With PickMyTrade
automation.myfunded_unique_pmt_p: MFFU has no native TradingView broker panel, so PickMyTrade is the bridge between your alerts and your funded account. Tradovate-based Core, Rapid, and Pro accounts connect at pickmytrade.trade; Rithmic-cleared accounts, including NinjaTrader users, connect at pickmytrade.io. After linking your MFFU broker connection, use Generate Alert to produce a webhook URL and JSON payload — paste the webhook into your TradingView alert and the JSON into the alert message, and every signal routes straight to your account, whichever plan or drawdown model it runs on.
automation.myfunded_faq_subtitle: Answers specific to running PickMyTrade automation on a MyFundedFutures Core, Rapid, Pro, Flex, or Builder account.
automation.myfunded_faq_1_q: Does MyFundedFutures allow TradingView automation through PickMyTrade?
automation.myfunded_faq_1_a: Yes. MFFU explicitly permits semi-automated trading and third-party execution tools, so a PickMyTrade webhook that fires your TradingView alerts into a Tradovate-connected MFFU account is compliant, as long as you monitor the strategy and stay under MFFU's cap of 200 trades per day for algorithmic activity. Fully unsupervised, autonomous bots are not allowed.
automation.myfunded_faq_2_q: Will PickMyTrade break MyFundedFutures' consistency rule?
automation.myfunded_faq_2_a: No. PickMyTrade only routes and sizes the orders your TradingView alerts generate — it doesn't change how MFFU calculates the 50% evaluation consistency rule on Rapid, Flex, and Pro, or the 40% funded-cycle rule on Core. Since the rule is a look-back check on your total profit history rather than a real-time cap, you trade with automation exactly as you would manually; just watch your best day relative to your cumulative total, the same way you would without it.
automation.myfunded_faq_3_q: Which MyFundedFutures plans can I connect through PickMyTrade?
automation.myfunded_faq_3_a: All of them, as long as the account runs on Tradovate or Rithmic. Core, Rapid, and Pro accounts on Tradovate connect at pickmytrade.trade; Rithmic-cleared accounts, including NinjaTrader users, connect at pickmytrade.io. Flex and Builder accounts follow the same connection flow, since MFFU clears every plan through the same Tradovate/Rithmic infrastructure.
automation.myfunded_faq_4_q: Does using PickMyTrade affect my MyFundedFutures drawdown calculation?
automation.myfunded_faq_4_a: No. Your drawdown — 3% EOD trailing on Core and Pro, 4% intraday trailing on Rapid — is calculated by MFFU's own risk engine off account equity, not by PickMyTrade. What PickMyTrade adds is risk tooling on the alert side: trailing-stop placeholders, percentage- or points-based position sizing, and a max-loss kill switch you can set well inside MFFU's drawdown before it's ever tested.
automation.myfunded_faq_5_q: What happens to my automated strategy around MyFundedFutures payouts or resets?
automation.myfunded_faq_5_a: Nothing changes on the PickMyTrade side — it keeps executing your TradingView alerts on whichever account is currently active. On MFFU's side, a Rapid account that nets $10,000 in a single day triggers a review toward live capital, and any account that renews unbreached is credited a free reset. Neither event requires touching your PickMyTrade webhook or alert configuration.
automation.take_profit_unique_subtitle: TPT's three-tier Test → PRO → PRO+ path changes what your TradingView automation needs to account for at each stage — real 2026 numbers on evaluation rules, splits, payouts, and TPT's automation policy, not just platform basics.
automation.take_profit_unique_fact1_desc: TPT runs a single 1-step Test evaluation with a 6% profit target that scales by account size ($1,500 on the $25K account up to $9,000 on $150K), a 5-minimum-trading-day requirement, an end-of-day trailing drawdown, and a consistency rule capping any one day at roughly 50% of total evaluation profit. Pass it and you move to PRO, a sim-funded account; clear $5,000 in profit on PRO and TPT invites you to upgrade to PRO+, a live Tradovate brokerage account with real exchange fills.
automation.take_profit_unique_fact2_h3: 80/20 Now, 90/10 Later — Mind the Drawdown Switch
automation.take_profit_unique_fact2_desc: PRO pays an 80/20 split and PRO+ bumps that to 90/10, but the rule traders miss is the drawdown model switching in between: PRO's trailing drawdown locks intraday, tightening on every new unrealized high, while both the Test phase and PRO+ use a gentler end-of-day lock. A strategy tuned for EOD trailing can breach a PRO account's tighter intraday floor without warning — a common reason freshly funded accounts fail in week one.
automation.take_profit_unique_fact3_h3: TradingView Automation Is Supported — Mass Copying Isn't
automation.take_profit_unique_fact3_desc: TPT permits trader-initiated automation: your own TradingView strategy or indicator firing webhook alerts that a bridge like PickMyTrade routes to your Tradovate account. What's restricted is unattended black-box bots trading without your oversight and mass-broadcast copy trading — identical fills mirrored across many accounts in milliseconds. Automation and multi-account policy details change over time, so confirm TPT's current rules before connecting a funded account.
automation.take_profit_unique_fact4_h3: Up to 5 Accounts, No Opposing Positions
automation.take_profit_unique_fact4_desc: Traders can run up to five active PRO/PRO+ accounts at once, but TPT prohibits holding opposing positions — long on one account, short on another — in the same or closely related instrument. PickMyTrade can apply random per-account timing jitter (200–500ms) and contract-count variation across connected TPT accounts so fills don't look like a mirrored copy pattern.
automation.take_profit_unique_fact5_desc: TPT pays on demand rather than on a fixed weekly or monthly cycle — request once your account clears its buffer (starting balance plus the account's max drawdown, e.g. $52,000 on a $50,000 account with a $2,000 drawdown), and PRO accounts are eligible from day one. automation.tradeify_unique_subtitle: Real rules pulled from Tradeify's own help center and its March 2026 "Tradeify 3.0" update, checked against multiple sources - here's how they should shape your automated TradingView-to-Tradovate setup.
automation.tradeify_unique_card1_h3: Automation Is Explicitly Allowed - With Ownership Rules
automation.tradeify_unique_card1_p: Tradeify is one of the more automation-friendly futures prop firms: personal bots, EAs, and TradingView webhook automation like PickMyTrade are explicitly allowed on both evaluation and funded accounts. The catch is ownership - Tradeify can require proof you're the sole owner of the strategy (including a live screen recording of you enabling it on your own PC) and bans high-frequency trading, rented or shared bots, and any form of trade copying between different traders' accounts. A PickMyTrade webhook feeding your own Tradeify account fits squarely inside these rules; sharing that same webhook with someone else's account does not.
automation.tradeify_unique_card2_p: Tradeify's consistency rule differs by account family and can change as the firm updates its rules, so confirm the current figures in Tradeify's help center before you go live. As of the Tradeify 3.0 rules: Select Evaluation caps your best single day at 40% of total profit during the eval (no consistency requirement once funded), Growth's evaluation carries no consistency rule at all, and Lightning Funded (which skips the evaluation entirely) applies a graduating 20/25/30% best-day cap that tightens as your payout count climbs. Because one outsized automated winning trade can trip these caps without warning, PickMyTrade's daily P&L limits and per-trade risk caps let you throttle a bot's position size so it can't accidentally break the rule.
automation.tradeify_unique_card3_p: Every Tradeify account family - Select, Growth, and Lightning - uses an end-of-day (EOD) trailing drawdown rather than a tick-by-tick intraday trail. The floor only ratchets upward when your balance locks in at the daily close, but the limit is still enforced in real time during the session: touch it intraday and the account fails immediately, it does not wait for end of day. On a $50,000 account the numbers are typically in the range of a $2,000 trailing drawdown and roughly a $1,250 daily loss limit, though exact figures vary by plan and account size, so verify Tradeify's current rules before sizing a bot's risk. PickMyTrade lets you attach a hard stop-loss to every webhook order (in points, ticks, percentage, or total dollars), so you can build a buffer under Tradeify's limits and keep a string of automated losses from silently walking the account toward a breach.
automation.tradeify_unique_card4_p: Under Tradeify 3.0, Growth and Lightning funded traders keep 100% of their first $15,000 in cumulative withdrawals before the split shifts to the standard 90/10; Select accounts run 90/10 from your very first payout. Payouts are processed daily and are commonly reported as landing within hours of approval, with first-payout minimums that scale by account size and payout count - roughly $1,500 on a $50,000 account, rising toward $2,500 by the fifth payout window, per Tradeify's published payout policy (always re-check the current thresholds, since prop firms adjust these often). Fast, frequent payout windows mean an automation mistake compounds quickly, so most PickMyTrade users cross-check the alert log and trade history export against every automated fill before requesting a payout.
automation.tradeify_unique_pmt_p: Tradeify accounts run on Tradovate, so setup follows the same flow described above: Tradeify emails your Tradovate login at activation for Select, Growth, and Lightning accounts alike, you log into Tradovate once to confirm access, and the account then shows up ready to link inside PickMyTrade with your Tradovate credentials. Because Tradeify can ask you to verify that you personally own and control any automated strategy, keep your TradingView alert and PickMyTrade webhook tied to a single Tradeify login rather than broadcasting the same signal into accounts under other traders' names - Tradeify's rules explicitly ban that kind of shared-bot or trade-copying setup. Running the same signal across multiple Tradeify accounts that you personally own is fine with PickMyTrade's multi-account tools; if Tradeify ever asks you to verify ownership, a short screen recording of your PickMyTrade dashboard firing an alert into your own Tradovate account is normally enough.
automation.tradeify_faq_h2: Frequently Asked Questions About Automating Tradeify
automation.tradeify_faq_1_q: Does Tradeify allow TradingView webhook automation through PickMyTrade?
automation.tradeify_faq_1_a: Yes. Tradeify explicitly permits personal bots, Expert Advisors, and webhook-driven automation like PickMyTrade on both evaluation and funded accounts, as long as you're not running high-frequency trading or a rented or shared bot. Since PickMyTrade routes your own TradingView alerts into your own Tradovate-hosted Tradeify account, it fits within Tradeify's automation policy - always double-check Tradeify's current Guidelines for Traders before going live, since prop firm rules can change without notice.
automation.tradeify_faq_2_q: Do I need to prove I own my automated strategy before running it on Tradeify?
automation.tradeify_faq_2_a: Tradeify can ask you to verify that you're the sole owner of any bot or automated strategy connected to your account, which can include a live screen recording of you enabling the code on your own PC. If you use PickMyTrade to route TradingView alerts into your Tradeify account, keep the webhook and TradingView account tied to you alone - Tradeify prohibits sharing a bot or webhook across multiple traders' accounts, or any form of trade copying between different users.
automation.tradeify_faq_3_q: Can PickMyTrade help me avoid breaking Tradeify's consistency rule?
automation.tradeify_faq_3_a: It can help, but you still have to configure it. Tradeify's consistency rule varies by plan - roughly a 40% single-day cap during Select evaluation and a tiered 20/25/30% cap on Lightning Funded accounts - so a single oversized automated winning trade can breach the rule even if your overall risk was reasonable. PickMyTrade lets you set daily profit and loss caps and per-trade position sizing on the webhook, which you can use to keep any one day's automated gain under Tradeify's current threshold; you're still responsible for checking the exact percentage that applies to your account type.
automation.tradeify_faq_4_q: Does Tradeify's end-of-day trailing drawdown change how I should set stop-losses in PickMyTrade?
automation.tradeify_faq_4_a: Yes. Tradeify's trailing drawdown locks in at the end-of-day close rather than trailing tick-by-tick intraday, but a breach during the session still fails the account immediately - it isn't forgiven until end of day. Because PickMyTrade can attach a stop-loss to every automated order (by points, ticks, percentage, or total dollar amount) and supports trailing-stop automation, most Tradeify traders build in a buffer well inside the daily loss limit rather than sizing trades right up to it.
automation.tradeify_faq_5_q: Can I use PickMyTrade to copy my Tradeify trades to another account or trader?
automation.tradeify_faq_5_a: You can copy your own signal across multiple Tradeify accounts that you personally own using PickMyTrade's multi-account and multiplier tools - that's standard practice. What you can't do is share that same bot, webhook, or signal with a different trader's account: Tradeify's rules explicitly prohibit team trading, collaborative trading, and any form of trade copying between separate users, regardless of the software used to do it.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_subtitle: Current, firm-specific numbers for Alpha Futures as of 2026 — evaluation structure, drawdown, consistency rule, payouts, and its automation policy — so you can size and configure an automated TradingView-to-Tradovate strategy correctly.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card1_h3: One-Step Evaluation, No Minimum Trading Days
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card1_p: Alpha Futures runs a single-step evaluation across its three active plans as of 2026 — Zero, Advanced, and Direct (the Premium plan was retired in July 2026) — with account sizes from $25,000 to $150,000. There is no published minimum number of trading days or time limit to pass, so a fast automated strategy can in theory clear a Zero evaluation in a single session. Advanced and Direct evaluations carry a consistency rule that mathematically forces at least two profitable days, so a true one-day pass isn't realistic on every plan.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card2_h3: Consistency Rule Depends on Plan and Stage
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card2_p: Unlike a single flat percentage, Alpha Futures' consistency rule changes by plan and by stage: no rule during Zero evaluations, a 50% rule during Advanced evaluations (no single day can exceed half of total profit), and once funded, 40% for Zero Qualified accounts, 20% for Direct Qualified, and no consistency requirement at all on Advanced Qualified accounts. If your automated strategy tends to produce one outsized winning day, use PickMyTrade's per-account quantity multiplier to size trades down on accounts where you're close to breaching the ratio. Confirm the exact current figures with Alpha Futures, since prop firm rules change.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card3_p: Alpha Futures uses an end-of-day trailing Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) that updates from your prior session's closing balance rather than trailing every tick intraday, so an open position that dips against you mid-session and recovers by the close won't drag the limit down the way a true intraday trailing drawdown would. Limits scale with account size — roughly $2,000 on a $50K Zero account and $3,500 on a $100K Advanced account, as examples. Confirm the exact figure for your plan and size before setting automated stop-loss levels.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card4_h3: Payouts Up to 4x a Month, 90% Split
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card4_p: Once you're a Qualified trader, Alpha Futures lets you request a payout up to four times a month after logging five winning trading days of at least $200 profit each (they don't need to be consecutive). Each request can pull up to 50% of your account's profit, you keep 90% of the amount requested, and payouts go out by ACH, wire, SWIFT, Wise, or Rise. Minimum payout amounts differ by plan — around $200 on Zero, $500 on Direct, and $1,000 on Advanced.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card5_h3: Semi-Automated Signals Allowed, Full Automation Banned
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card5_p: Alpha Futures' rules explicitly prohibit fully automated, hands-off bots and EAs on every account type, but they just as explicitly permit semi-automated trading — a signal or indicator that a trader manually places, monitors, and manages. That distinction matters for how you run PickMyTrade: treat alerts as trade signals you actively watch rather than a walk-away system, and confirm Alpha Futures' current automation policy directly with them before going live. Alpha Futures also enforces an anti-scalping rule against a consistent pattern of trades held under 2 minutes and moving fewer than 10 ticks, worth keeping in mind when you set tick- or point-based stops in your alerts.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_card6_p: As of July 12, 2026, Alpha Futures and NinjaTrader/Tradovate ended their platform partnership. Alpha Futures can no longer issue new accounts on Tradovate, and existing Zero, Advanced, and Direct accounts connected through Tradovate were migrated to Alpha Futures' own AlphaTrader platform. The Tradovate-based setup on this page applies to accounts that remain on Tradovate — before connecting, check your Alpha Futures dashboard or contact their support to confirm which platform your account currently runs on.
automation.alpha_futures_unique_pmt_h3: Connecting Your Alpha Futures Tradovate Account to PickMyTrade
automation.alpha_futures_unique_pmt_p: If your Alpha Futures account is still connected through Tradovate, the same demo and live connection steps above apply directly — link the account inside PickMyTrade, generate your alert and webhook URL, and paste it into your TradingView alert. Because Alpha Futures moved existing Tradovate accounts to its own AlphaTrader platform starting July 2026 and stopped issuing new Tradovate accounts, confirm your account's current platform before setting anything up. PickMyTrade adds no extra per-account fee, so once connected you can run the identical signal — sized appropriately for each account's drawdown and consistency rule — across every Alpha Futures evaluation and funded account you own, without paying more per account.

automation.alpha_futures_faq_3_q: How does Alpha Futures' consistency rule affect an automated TradingView strategy?
automation.alpha_futures_faq_3_a: The rule varies by plan and stage — for example, a 50% cap during Advanced evaluations, no rule on Zero evaluations, and 40%/20%/none on Zero, Direct, and Advanced Qualified accounts respectively. An automated strategy that fires the same size trade on every account can accidentally produce one oversized winning day on a smaller account. automation.alpha_futures_faq_4_a: Alpha Futures uses an end-of-day trailing Maximum Loss Limit that moves with your prior session's closing balance rather than trailing intraday tick by tick. PickMyTrade's points, percentage, or tick-based auto stop-loss placeholders let you set a hard exit well inside that limit; size it against your plan's published Maximum Loss Limit for your account size, not a generic percentage, and re-check the figure if you resize or reset the account.

automation.fundednext_unique_subtitle: Profit splits, drawdown mechanics, the 2026 Rapid Pro/Rapid Daily relaunch, and FundedNext Futures' own automation policy - the details that actually change how you should configure a TradingView-to-Tradovate strategy on this firm.
automation.fundednext_unique_fact1_h3: Reward Share: 80% Standard, Up To 90% On Newer Plans
automation.fundednext_unique_fact1_desc: As of 2026, FundedNext Futures pays an 80% reward share on Legacy Challenge and base Flex Challenge accounts. The Rapid Pro and Rapid Daily paths introduced in July 2026 pay 90%, and Flex traders can pay extra at checkout to upgrade their split to 90% as well. That's lower than the "up to 95%" some marketing pages still advertise, so confirm the current split for your specific plan on FundedNext's own site before you size an automated strategy around it.
automation.fundednext_unique_fact2_h3: 2026 Lineup: Legacy, Flex, Rapid Pro & Rapid Daily
automation.fundednext_unique_fact2_desc: Effective July 10, 2026, FundedNext retired the original Rapid Challenge and the Bolt $50K account for new purchases and resets. The current lineup is Legacy Challenge (fixed profit target, minimum 5 trading days), Flex Challenge (no minimum trading days during the challenge, no daily loss limit), and the new Rapid Pro (payout requests roughly every 3 days, no daily loss limit) and Rapid Daily (a daily loss limit applies, but payouts are available from as early as day two with no consistency rule at any stage).
automation.fundednext_unique_fact3_desc: Every current FundedNext Futures account model uses an end-of-day trailing maximum loss limit rather than a static or intraday-trailing one: the floor ratchets up once per day based on your highest closed-day balance and locks for good once the account reaches its starting balance plus a small buffer. Because the trail only moves at the daily close, an automated strategy that gives back an intraday gain before the session ends won't get credit for that peak - size stops with that mechanic in mind, not an intraday trail.
automation.fundednext_unique_fact4_h3: EAs, Bots & Webhook Automation Are Explicitly Allowed
automation.fundednext_unique_fact4_desc: FundedNext Futures' published rules explicitly permit automated trading systems, including EAs and bots, on both the Challenge and funded FundedNext Account, through any platform integration that connects to Tradovate - which covers a webhook bridge like PickMyTrade. The catch: FundedNext offers no technical support for setting up or troubleshooting third-party automation, and strategies built to exploit system vulnerabilities, such as latency abuse or order flooding, are strictly prohibited.
automation.fundednext_unique_fact5_desc: The minimum withdrawal is $250, and FundedNext applies a processing fee of up to 3.5% on each payout request. Legacy and Flex funded accounts generally need around 5 benchmark days before the first withdrawal; Rapid Pro pays roughly every 3 days and Rapid Daily as early as day two. FundedNext advertises a 24-hour payout guarantee backed by a stated $1,000 commitment if it's missed, and traders commonly report payouts landing within hours - though as with any prop firm, confirm current processing times directly with FundedNext.
automation.fundednext_unique_fact6_h3: High Trustpilot Score, Recurring Support Complaints
automation.fundednext_unique_fact6_desc: FundedNext sits around 4.5 out of 5 on Trustpilot from tens of thousands of reviews, and traders most often cite fast, reliable payouts as the standout. The recurring complaint across Trustpilot and prop-firm review sites is customer support: an AI-driven chatbot that some traders say gives generic answers and closes tickets before an issue is resolved, plus occasional disputes over payout or reset terms - a reminder to keep your own records and read the current rules before leaning on automation for compliance-sensitive limits.
automation.fundednext_unique_pmt_h3: Setting up FundedNext Futures with PickMyTrade
automation.fundednext_unique_pmt_p: FundedNext Futures accounts run on Tradovate (NinjaTrader, TradingView-via-Tradovate and Rithmic are also supported), so the connection steps above apply as-is: log in with your FundedNext Tradovate credentials, link the Challenge or funded account in PickMyTrade, and route your TradingView alerts to every connected Legacy, Flex, Rapid Pro or Rapid Daily account from one dashboard. Because FundedNext's own rules explicitly allow platform-integration automation like this, orders process in under 200ms on our side, and one PickMyTrade plan covers every FundedNext Futures account you connect - there's no extra per-account fee on our end, though FundedNext's own account-count rules still apply.

automation.fundednext_faq_4_a: On Legacy, Flex and Rapid Pro accounts, no single day's profit can exceed 40% of your total profit (during the Challenge), and the same 40% cap gates withdrawal eligibility once you're funded - FundedNext doesn't breach the account for breaking it, it just blocks withdrawal until your best day drops back under that share. Rapid Daily has no consistency rule at any stage. automation.fundednext_faq_5_q: How and when can I withdraw profits from a FundedNext Futures account?

copier.apex_intro_p1: An Apex trade copier mirrors one trade to all of your Apex Trader Funding accounts at the same time. PickMyTrade's Manual Trade Copier does this by replicating an order you place yourself — by hand, in an account you're actively trading — across every other Apex account you connect, with matching stop loss and take profit prices and no VPS to run. This is a different shape from a TradingView alert firing the order directly; see below for what Apex's rules mean for each. Apex Trader Funding is one of the most popular futures prop firms, with Apex 4.0 funded accounts from $25,000 to $150,000.
copier.apex_intro_p2: While Apex uses Tradovate as their trading platform, there's no built-in copy trading functionality. This guide will walk you through how to set up professional trade copying with your Apex Trader Funding accounts using PickMyTrade.
copier.apex_intro_p3: Whether you're managing multiple evaluation accounts or copying trades to funded accounts, this guide covers everything you need to know.
copier.apex_feat1_p: Stay compliant with Apex's consistency rule (50% on 4.0 accounts, 30% on Legacy 3.0) and trailing drawdown limits using built-in position limits and safeguards.
copier.apex_feat3_p: Copy trades across all your Apex evaluation and funded accounts at once, up to Apex's 20-account cap per trader. PickMyTrade itself adds no extra account limit or per-account fee.
copier.apex_usecase1_p: Pass multiple Apex evaluations simultaneously by copying trades from your main account to all evaluation accounts at once.
copier.apex_practice3_p: Be aware of Apex's consistency rule (50% on 4.0 accounts, 30% on Legacy 3.0) and trailing drawdown. Configure your copy settings to stay compliant.
copier.apex_vs_h2: Apex trade copier vs other copiers
copier.apex_vs_p1: There are a few ways to copy trades on Apex, and they suit different traders. Apex's own Tradovate Group Copier mirrors fills between your Apex accounts that sit under one Tradovate login, which is handy if you place trades manually inside Tradovate. copier.blue_guardian_profile_fact1_desc: Blue Guardian Futures pays 100% of your first $15,000 in profit, then splits 90/10 in your favor after that threshold - one of the more generous splits among Tradovate-based futures prop firms as of 2026. copier.blue_guardian_profile_fact2_desc: Blue Guardian Futures uses an end-of-day trailing drawdown that locks in at the prior day's close, so intraday dips don't count against you as long as you close the day within the limit. copier.blue_guardian_profile_fact3_desc: There's no activation fee on funded Standard or Instant accounts. copier.blue_guardian_profile_fact6_desc: Blue Guardian Futures explicitly permits copy trading, including through third-party software like PickMyTrade, between accounts you personally own, including your own external accounts. Blue Guardian Futures runs a one-step evaluation with a 6-8% profit target and an end-of-day trailing drawdown, depending on your plan (Standard, Guardian or Instant), and PickMyTrade doesn't touch any of that - it simply replicates each entry, exit, stop-loss and take-profit from your master account onto every connected follower account automatically.
copier.blue_guardian_faq_2_q: Does Blue Guardian Futures allow copying trades across multiple accounts?
copier.blue_guardian_faq_2_a: Yes. Blue Guardian Futures's own rules state that copy trading, including through third-party software such as PickMyTrade, is allowed between accounts you personally own, including your own external accounts. What's prohibited is copying trades from other traders, signal providers or trade groups, or letting a third party manage or execute trades on your behalf - that can trigger an account review or termination. There's no limit on the number of evaluation accounts you can run, but combined active funded allocation is capped at $400,000 across all funded accounts as of 2026, so confirm the current limits directly with Blue Guardian Futures before connecting several funded accounts to a copier.
copier.blue_guardian_faq_3_q: Does PickMyTrade support Blue Guardian Futures on Tradovate?
copier.blue_guardian_faq_3_a: Yes. Blue Guardian Futures accounts run on Tradovate (alongside ProjectX, as of 2026), and PickMyTrade connects to Tradovate directly through a one-click OAuth login - no API keys or extra software required.
copier.blue_guardian_faq_4_q: What position-sizing options exist per follower account?
copier.blue_guardian_faq_4_a: Each connected Blue Guardian Futures account gets its own quantity multiplier, so a follower account can copy a different position size than the master. This matters more with Blue Guardian Futures because daily loss limits and drawdown differ by plan - a Standard account carries a daily loss limit that a Guardian account doesn't - so a multiplier that's safe on one plan can be too aggressive on another. Stop-loss and take-profit can also be set per account using points, percentage, ticks, price level, or total profit and loss, plus optional trailing stops.
copier.blue_guardian_faq_5_q: Is there a delay between the master trade and the follower fills?
copier.blue_guardian_faq_5_a: PickMyTrade processes each order in under 200ms on our side once the source trade or TradingView alert fires. The total time you see the fill on each Blue Guardian Futures account also depends on Tradovate and current market conditions, not just PickMyTrade's processing time. Blue Guardian Futures also resets its daily loss value each day at 5pm ET using the higher of balance or equity at that moment, so trades that fire right around the reset can land on either side of that daily window.
copier.blue_guardian_faq_6_q: Does copying trades affect Blue Guardian Futures's drawdown or consistency rules?
copier.blue_guardian_faq_6_a: PickMyTrade doesn't calculate or enforce any prop firm's drawdown or consistency rules. Blue Guardian Futures applies no consistency rule during the evaluation phase, but funded accounts must clear one before a payout - roughly 30% on Guardian funded accounts and up to 40% on Standard funded accounts as of 2026 - and its drawdown is an end-of-day trailing limit that varies by plan and account size. Because copying sends the same trade to every connected account at once, a single loss or a single large win applies to every connected account simultaneously, which can push one account past its consistency threshold or drawdown limit even while your others stay compliant. Confirm Blue Guardian Futures's current rules directly with Blue Guardian Futures before connecting an evaluation or funded account, and size your copied trades accordingly.
copier.blue_guardian_faq_7_q: Can I copy manual trades, not just TradingView alerts, to my Blue Guardian Futures accounts?
copier.blue_guardian_faq_7_a: Yes. Alongside the TradingView webhook method, PickMyTrade includes a manual trade copier: place a trade by hand on your source account and it replicates automatically across your connected Blue Guardian Futures accounts.
copier.blue_guardian_faq_8_q: Why use PickMyTrade instead of copying trades across Blue Guardian Futures accounts by hand?
copier.blue_guardian_faq_8_a: Manually re-entering the same trade on several accounts is slow, easy to mistime, and doesn't scale once you're holding more than one or two accounts - and Blue Guardian Futures places no cap on the number of evaluation accounts you can run at once, so traders scaling multiple evaluations feel this the most. PickMyTrade automates the entry, exit, stop-loss and take-profit across every connected Blue Guardian Futures account from a single signal, so you can focus on the strategy instead of repeating the same clicks across a growing account list.

copier.top_one_faq_8_q: Why use PickMyTrade instead of copying trades across Top One Futures accounts by hand?

copier.topstep_profile_subtitle: The rules, costs and platform details that actually shape how you run a Topstep trade copier, current as of 2026.
copier.topstep_profile_fact1_desc: Traders keep 90% of every approved payout. Accounts opened before January 12, 2026 keep 100% of their first $10,000 in lifetime profit across all accounts before the 90/10 split applies; accounts opened after that date are 90/10 from the first dollar.
copier.topstep_profile_fact2_desc: Topstep's Maximum Loss Limit only moves up with your prior end-of-day closing balance and locks permanently once you reach your starting balance - it never trails down. Trading Combines start $2,000 below balance at every size; Express Funded Accounts carry a $2,000-$4,500 MLL depending on size.
copier.topstep_profile_fact3_desc: The standard Trading Combine costs $49/$99/$149 a month for the $50K/$100K/$150K size, plus a one-time $149 activation fee once you pass. A no-activation-fee path is also available at $95/$149/$229 a month for traders who'd rather skip the upfront charge.
copier.topstep_profile_fact4_desc: Express Funded Account payouts are capped at 50% of your reward balance, up to $5,000 on the Standard path or $6,000 on the Consistency path per request; Live Funded Account payouts are uncapped. International traders are paid via Wise, Aeropay or SWIFT wire.
copier.topstep_profile_fact5_h4: Two Paths to the 50% Consistency Rule
copier.topstep_profile_fact5_desc: Trading Combine passes require your best single day to stay under 50% of the profit target. On an Express Funded Account, the Standard path needs 5 winning days of $150+ before your first payout; the Consistency path needs just 3 trading days but caps any one day at 40% of total profit.
copier.topstep_profile_fact6_h4: Automation Allowed - Except on Live Funded
copier.topstep_profile_fact6_desc: Topstep permits automated and webhook-driven trading, including copying across your own accounts, on the Trading Combine and Express Funded accounts, but not on a Live Funded Account. Copying another trader's signals is banned, and copy-trading connections auto-pause while a payout request is processing.
copier.topstep_faq_1_q: What is a Topstep trade copier, and how does it work with PickMyTrade?
copier.topstep_faq_1_a: A Topstep trade copier takes one source trade - a TradingView alert or a manual entry - and mirrors the entry, exit, stop-loss and take-profit across every connected Topstep account at once, instead of you re-entering the same trade by hand on each one. Topstep completed its move to TopstepX, built on the ProjectX API, in 2026 and retired its legacy NinjaTrader, Tradovate and TradingView broker connections; PickMyTrade copies trades to your Topstep accounts through that same ProjectX/TopstepX API bridge it uses for TradingView automation, so you can still run a TradingView-based strategy across multiple Topstep accounts without placing each order by hand.
copier.topstep_faq_2_q: Can I copy trades across multiple Topstep Trading Combine and Express Funded accounts at once?
copier.topstep_faq_2_a: Yes, up to Topstep's own limits. Topstep caps a trader at 5 funded accounts total (Express Funded Accounts plus one Live Funded Account) and a combined $750,000 in funded capital, while Trading Combine subscriptions can run unlimited and concurrently. PickMyTrade lets you connect every one of those accounts and copy a single signal to all of them, with a separate quantity multiplier per account, so scaling across multiple Combines and funded accounts doesn't mean manually repeating every trade.
copier.topstep_faq_3_q: Does PickMyTrade help me stay under Topstep's Maximum Loss Limit (MLL) when copying trades?
copier.topstep_faq_3_a: Topstep's MLL is an end-of-day trailing drawdown: the limit only moves up with your previous day's closing balance, never trails down, and locks permanently once your balance reaches your original starting balance - though breaches are still monitored in real time during the session. Every Trading Combine starts $2,000 below its starting balance regardless of size, while Express Funded Accounts carry a $2,000/$3,000/$4,500 MLL on the $50K/$100K/$150K size. PickMyTrade doesn't calculate or enforce the MLL for you, but its per-account quantity multipliers and stop-loss/take-profit settings let you size copied trades differently on each connected account, which is useful when some of your Topstep accounts sit closer to their MLL floor than others. Staying compliant with Topstep's current MLL rules is still your responsibility.
copier.topstep_faq_4_q: Does copying the same trade to several accounts create problems with Topstep's Consistency Rule?
copier.topstep_faq_4_a: It can, so it's worth planning around. On the Trading Combine, your best single day can't exceed 50% of the profit target. On an Express Funded Account, the Standard payout path instead requires 5 separate winning days of at least $150 each, while the Consistency path needs a minimum of 3 trading days and caps any single day at 40% of total profit. Because a copier fires the same trade on every connected account at once, one large winning trade echoes across all of them simultaneously, which can make that day's profit concentration larger than it would be trading each account independently. Size copied trades with that in mind.
copier.topstep_faq_5_q: Does a trade copier trigger Topstep's Daily Loss Limit?
copier.topstep_faq_5_a: Topstep removed the default Daily Loss Limit on every Combine and Express Funded Account effective August 25, 2024; the only DLL today is an optional, self-set "Personal Daily Loss Limit" you configure yourself inside TopstepX, free of charge. If you've turned one on for a follower account, a copier that mirrors the same trade across several accounts can trip that self-imposed limit on more than one account at the same time. You can adjust or disable your Personal DLL per account at any time.
copier.topstep_faq_6_q: Can I copy trades to a Trading Combine and a funded account at the same time?
copier.topstep_faq_6_a: Yes. PickMyTrade doesn't distinguish between evaluation and funded Topstep accounts - if it's connected through your Topstep broker connection, it can be set up as a follower. A common setup is copying one signal from a master account to several Trading Combines and an existing Express Funded or Live Funded Account together, so a single trade advances more than one evaluation while also trading a funded account.
copier.topstep_faq_7_q: Can I copy manual trades, or only TradingView alerts, to my Topstep accounts?
copier.topstep_faq_7_a: Both. Alongside the TradingView webhook method, PickMyTrade includes a manual trade copier: place a trade by hand on your source account and it replicates automatically across your connected Topstep accounts, using the same ProjectX/TopstepX bridge as the automated alert path.
copier.topstep_faq_8_q: Why use PickMyTrade instead of manually re-entering trades on every Topstep account?
copier.topstep_faq_8_a: With Topstep's Trading Combine running $49-$149 a month by account size plus a one-time $149 activation fee, and up to 5 funded accounts allowed per trader under the $750,000 cap, most active traders are running several accounts at once - manually copying one trade across every one of them by hand is slow and error-prone, and a missed stop or mis-sized order can jeopardize a Combine or funded account. PickMyTrade replicates the entry, exit, stop-loss and take-profit automatically and consistently across every connected Topstep account, in under 200ms on our side.

compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_arch_title: Cloud or Desktop — How Does Each Platform's Architecture Work?
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_arch_p1: The most impactful difference between these platforms is their architecture. PickMyTrade runs entirely in the cloud. When a TradingView alert fires, the webhook hits PickMyTrade's servers, which process the signal and route the order to Tradovate within seconds. Your computer can be off, your browser closed, and your phone in your pocket — the trade still executes.
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_arch_p2: PineConnector uses a desktop-based flow. A special TradingView indicator sends signals through PineConnector's relay, which then reaches an Expert Advisor running on your MetaTrader platform. Many PineConnector users pair this with a VPS for continuous operation, giving them local control over their trading environment.
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_arch_p3: For traders who value a hands-off approach, PickMyTrade's cloud-based architecture means there is no infrastructure to manage. The platform handles uptime, connectivity, and execution automatically. This is especially valuable for prop firm traders where consistent execution is important for meeting evaluation criteria.

PickMyTrade's primary integration is Tradovate, the leading futures broker platform used by prop firms like Apex Trader Funding, My Funded Futures, and Topstep. It also supports Rithmic, Interactive Brokers, TradeLocker, TradeStation, ProjectX, Matchtrader, Tradier (Beta), cTrader (Beta) and Ironbeam (Beta).
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_broker_p2: PineConnector supports any broker that offers MT4 or MT5, which covers a broad range of forex and CFD brokers worldwide. This makes it a strong choice for traders in those markets. For futures traders on Tradovate working with contracts like ES, NQ, or CL, PickMyTrade is the purpose-built solution.

compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_setup_p1: PickMyTrade's setup process takes approximately 2 minutes: create an account, connect Tradovate via OAuth, and configure your TradingView webhook. compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_reliability_title: How Do PickMyTrade and PineConnector Compare on Reliability and Uptime?
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_reliability_p1: For automated trading, reliability is paramount. A missed trade during a volatile session can cost more than months of platform fees. The architectural difference between cloud and desktop directly impacts reliability.
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_reliability_p2: PickMyTrade's cloud infrastructure is maintained by the platform team with redundancy and monitoring. If a server has an issue, failover mechanisms handle it transparently. You do not need to worry about uptime, restarts, or connectivity. The platform has processed over 28 million trades for 50,000+ traders, demonstrating production-grade reliability at scale.
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_reliability_p3: PineConnector's desktop EA approach gives traders direct control over their execution environment. Traders who prefer managing their own infrastructure can configure their VPS and MetaTrader setup to their exact specifications. This hands-on approach appeals to technically inclined traders who want full visibility into their automation stack.
compare.vs_pineconnector_dive_reliability_p4: For traders who want a fully managed experience, PickMyTrade's cloud-native infrastructure provides peace of mind during high-impact events like FOMC rate decisions or Non-Farm Payrolls, when consistent execution matters most.

compare.vs_alertdragon_dive_multiaccount_p2: PickMyTrade includes dedicated multi-account copy trading with a master/follower relationship, quantity multiplier controls, and prop firm-specific workflow management. compare.vs_alertdragon_dive_execution_p1: Futures contracts like ES (S&P 500 E-mini), NQ (Nasdaq 100 E-mini), and CL (Crude Oil) can move multiple ticks in under a second during volatile sessions. The difference between a fill at your intended price and a fill 2-3 ticks away is real money. Multiply that by dozens of trades per day across multiple accounts, and execution speed becomes a major factor in overall profitability.
compare.vs_alertdragon_dive_execution_p2: PickMyTrade's infrastructure is optimized specifically for this scenario.
