prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_1_q: What is Earn2Trade and how does the funded futures program work?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_1_a: Earn2Trade is a US futures prop firm and trading education company founded in 2016. You pay a monthly subscription, take either the Gauntlet Mini (one-step) or the Trader Career Path (with built-in scaling), hit a 6% profit target with at least 10 trading days while respecting the EOD drawdown and consistency rule, then receive a guaranteed funding offer from one of two prop trading partners (Helios Trading Partners in the US, Appius Trading Limited in the UK). 80/20 profit split in your favor.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_2_q: When was Earn2Trade founded and how long has it been operating?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_2_a: Founded 2016 by Ryan Masten and David Lojko. Roughly a decade of operation as of 2026 - one of the older retail futures prop firms, predating most of the 2020-2024 wave.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_3_a: Sheridan, Wyoming, USA. The funded prop trading is handled through partner firms - Helios Trading Partners (US) and Appius Trading Limited (UK).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_4_a: David Lojko, who has managed the company since April 2019. Co-founder Ryan Masten departed in July 2020.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_5_q: Is Earn2Trade legit or a scam?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_5_a: Legit. ~4.7/5 on Trustpilot from roughly 4,700+ reviews. Withdrawals process weekly via Rise (with ACH, Wise, or local bank rails underneath) or direct crypto. Earn2Trade itself does not publish a public pass-rate statistic - older third-party numbers are not officially confirmed. Largest complaints in 2026 are about the 80/20 split being lower than Apex's 90% and the consistency rule feeling restrictive - not about payout integrity.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_6_a: Helios Trading Partners LLC is the US-based proprietary trading firm that funds traders who pass Earn2Trade's evaluations. Helios was established in 2016 by the same owners as Earn2Trade - they are affiliated entities under shared ownership, not arms-length partners. Your funded contract is signed with Helios (or Appius for some non-US traders), not directly with Earn2Trade.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_7_a: UK-based prop trading firm that's the second funding partner alongside Helios. Some non-US traders are routed to Appius depending on geography and regulatory fit.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_8_a: Earn2Trade is an education and evaluation company - not a regulated broker. Its prop trading partners (Helios, Appius) operate as proprietary trading firms, which in the US sit outside the retail-broker regulatory perimeter (no SIPC, no FINRA broker-dealer status). Standard for the prop firm industry.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_9_a: ~4.7 out of 5 from roughly 4,700+ reviews as of 2026 (some snapshots show 4.6) - among the highest of any major futures prop firm. Reviews consistently praise customer support (specific names like Ikbal, Ayush, Ysmarlin appear repeatedly) and payout reliability.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_10_a: Earn2Trade does not publish pass-rate statistics for the TCP or Gauntlet Mini. Older third-party blog posts cite specific percentages (such as 8.89% or 10.42%), but those numbers do not appear in current Earn2Trade help center articles or official communications - treat them as unverified. The firm's own messaging focuses on the funded-trader experience rather than pass-rate marketing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_programs_heading: What Are Earn2Trade's TCP, Gauntlet Mini, and Gauntlet Programs?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_11_q: What is the Trader Career Path (TCP)?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_11_a: The Trader Career Path is Earn2Trade's signature evaluation with a built-in scaling plan. You pass once, then grow your account through defined stages by hitting profit targets at each level - up to a maximum $200K (TCP25) or $400K (TCP50/TCP100) without taking another evaluation. Free monthly resets included with active subscription.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_12_a: The Gauntlet Mini is Earn2Trade's one-step intraday futures evaluation. 6% profit target, 10-day minimum, EOD drawdown. Pass and you're funded - but unlike TCP there's no built-in scaling plan, just immediate access to a single funded account size.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_13_q: What is the original Gauntlet (not Mini)?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_13_a: The original Gauntlet is the multi-stage evaluation tied to the Bootcamp education program - a 4-month structured course with weekly mentorship and webinars culminating in a longer Gauntlet examination. Most active retail traders today take the Gauntlet Mini or TCP because they're faster and don't bundle education they may not need.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_14_q: Is the original Gauntlet still available?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_14_a: It exists as part of the Bootcamp bundle (~$2,499 one-time). Standalone Gauntlet purchases are rare today - Earn2Trade actively promotes TCP and Gauntlet Mini as the primary funding paths for traders who don't need the full education curriculum.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_15_q: TCP vs Gauntlet Mini - which should I choose?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_15_a: Choose TCP if you want a long-term scaling path to $400K with the same plan. Choose Gauntlet Mini if you want the largest single-account size right out of the gate (up to $200K) without a scaling commitment. Both share rules; the difference is structural - TCP grows you incrementally, Gauntlet Mini hands you the size up front.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_16_q: Can I switch between TCP and Gauntlet Mini?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_16_a: You can cancel one and start the other, but you can't directly migrate active progress. Each evaluation is its own subscription. Most traders pick one and stick with it.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_17_q: Can I run multiple Earn2Trade accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_17_a: Yes - multiple subscriptions are allowed. But Earn2Trade's prohibited-conduct rules ban coordinating accounts to manipulate or hedge across them. Each account must be independently traded.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_18_q: Is the Gauntlet Mini a one-step or two-step evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_18_a: One-step. Hit 6% profit, do 10+ trading days, follow the rules - and you're done. No second-stage verification phase like FTMO-style forex props.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_19_a: Yes - the TCP evaluation is one-step. The "career path" multi-stage structure kicks in after you pass and become funded, where you scale up by hitting profit targets at each tier and withdrawing your share.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_20_q: Is there a time limit on the evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_20_a: No fixed deadline. Your subscription renews monthly until you pass, fail beyond reset, or cancel. Take as long as you need - though longer means more monthly fees.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_21_q: What happens if I pass the evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_21_a: You get a funding offer email from the prop firm partner (Helios or Appius). You sign their funded trader agreement, choose between a Live or LiveSim account, complete KYC, and start trading. Setup is ~2 business days for LiveSim, up to 10 days for Live.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_22_q: What happens if I fail the evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_22_a: Use your free monthly reset (one included per billing cycle) and start over. Or buy a paid reset (price varies by account size - see the Fees section). Or cancel and start a new evaluation later.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_sizes_heading: What Are Earn2Trade's Account Sizes and Profit Targets?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_23_q: What account sizes does the Trader Career Path offer?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_23_a: TCP25 ($25,000), TCP50 ($50,000), and TCP100 ($100,000) starting capital - named after the starting size in thousands.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_24_q: What account sizes does the Gauntlet Mini offer?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_24_a: GAU25 ($25,000), GAU50 ($50,000), GAU100 ($100,000), GAU150 ($150,000), and GAU200 ($200,000) - five sizes in total. The Gauntlet Mini matches TCP at the lower end and extends past TCP entry sizes at the top. TCP starts smaller but grows further via scaling.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_25_q: What's the profit target on each account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_25_a: 6% of starting capital, applied uniformly across both TCP and Gauntlet Mini. TCP25 / GAU25 = $1,500, TCP50 / GAU50 = $3,000, TCP100 / GAU100 = $6,000, GAU150 = $9,000, GAU200 = $12,000.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_26_q: Is the profit target a flat 6% or does it vary?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_26_a: Flat 6% across all TCP and Gauntlet Mini account sizes - same percentage applied to whatever starting balance you choose. TCP scaling stages also hit 6% at the $200K rung ($12,000 target). The $400K stage uses a fixed-drawdown structure with its own documented target - verify the current number on help.earn2trade.com before assuming, as it has shifted across plan revisions.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_27_q: What's the maximum account size with TCP25?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_27_a: $200,000. TCP25 scaling: $25K - $50K - $100K - $200K. The TCP25 plan does not access the $400K tier - only TCP50 and TCP100 do.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_28_q: What's the maximum account size with TCP50?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_29_q: What's the maximum account size with TCP100?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_29_a: $400,000. TCP100 scaling: $100K - $150K - $200K - $400K. Same $400K cap as TCP50, but TCP100 starts higher and progresses through different intermediate stages.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_30_q: What's the largest funded account I can ever get on Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_30_a: $400,000 - reachable only through TCP50 or TCP100 scaling. The Gauntlet Mini caps at $200K because it has no built-in scaling structure. To go above $200K via Earn2Trade you must be on the TCP path.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_31_q: What's the profit target at higher TCP scaling stages?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_31_a: $150K stage = $9,000 (6%). $200K stage = $12,000 (6%). $400K stage = a fixed-drawdown stage with its own documented target - refer to help.earn2trade.com for the current value, as Earn2Trade has revised it across plan iterations.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_32_q: Is there a starter account smaller than $25K?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_32_a: No. $25K (TCP25) is the smallest evaluation account at Earn2Trade. Apex offers a $25K account too; Topstep starts at $50K.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_drawdown_heading: What Are Earn2Trade's Drawdown, Daily Loss, and Risk Rules?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_33_q: What types of drawdown does Earn2Trade use?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_33_a: End-of-Day (EOD) drawdown across the board - evaluation, LiveSim, and Live funded accounts all use the same EOD model. The top TCP scaling stage uses a fixed-drawdown variant where the floor stops trailing once the account reaches its maximum size. Earn2Trade does not run an intraday trailing drawdown like Apex or Topstep - that is one of the firm's headline differentiators.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_34_a: End-of-Day drawdown calculates your minimum balance based on closed positions at the end of each trading day. Intraday dips don't count - only your closed-trade end-of-day balance does. Big advantage: you can ride out wide MAE on a winning trade without busting drawdown, as long as you close the day above the floor.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_35_q: Does Earn2Trade use a trailing (intraday) drawdown?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_35_a: No. Earn2Trade does not apply an intraday trailing drawdown on any account type - evaluation, LiveSim, and Live all use End-of-Day drawdown. Intraday equity dips never count against you while a position is open. This is a key contrast versus Apex or Topstep, where trailing drawdowns follow peak intraday equity tick-by-tick.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_36_q: What is fixed drawdown on Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_36_a: Fixed drawdown means the EOD drawdown floor stops trailing your high-water mark and locks in place once you reach the top scaling tier. It's used on the largest TCP scaling stage so the floor doesn't keep ratcheting up as you continue compounding. Earn2Trade documents the exact dollar floor in help.earn2trade.com - verify the current value there before sizing, as it has changed across plan revisions.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_37_q: What's the EOD drawdown amount on each account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_37_a: TCP25 / GAU25: $1,500. TCP50 / GAU50: $2,000. TCP100 / GAU100: $3,500 (same on both programs). GAU150: $4,500. GAU200: $6,000. These amounts apply consistently across evaluation, LiveSim, and Live accounts at the corresponding size.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_38_a: TCP25: $550. TCP50/GAU50: $1,100. TCP100/GAU100: $2,200. GAU150: $3,300. GAU200: $4,400. $150K scaled stage: $3,300. $200K scaled stage: $4,400. $400K scaled stage: $8,800. Hit or exceed the daily loss in a single trading day and the account fails for that day's session (rules vary by stage).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_39_q: Does the EOD drawdown ratchet up as I profit?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_39_a: Yes. EOD drawdown trails your highest end-of-day account balance - as the EOD balance climbs, the floor climbs with it (drawdown amount stays constant; floor moves up). Once the floor exceeds your starting balance, you're effectively locked above breakeven.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_40_q: Does Earn2Trade's drawdown stop trailing once I'm profitable?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_40_a: Earn2Trade's drawdown is EOD-only, so there is no intraday trailing to stop. The end-of-day floor ratchets up with your best closed-day balance (drawdown distance stays constant; floor rises). It locks in place permanently when you reach the top TCP scaling stage, which uses the fixed-drawdown variant.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_41_q: What happens when I hit the daily loss limit?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_41_a: Account is locked from trading for the rest of that day. On evaluation, this resets at next trading day's open. On funded accounts, repeated DLL breaches can trigger account closure depending on Helios/Appius's funded trader agreement.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_42_q: What happens when I bust the EOD drawdown?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_42_a: Account fails. On evaluation, you can use your free monthly reset (or buy a paid reset) to start over. On a funded LiveSim/Live account, busting drawdown closes the account and you'd need to take a new evaluation.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_43_q: Why is Earn2Trade's EOD drawdown friendlier than competitors' trailing models?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_43_a: EOD only counts your end-of-day closed balance. Intraday dips on a winning trade don't matter. At firms with trailing drawdown (Apex, Topstep), every tick of give-back can erode your floor - drop $500 of unrealized profit and the floor drops $500. EOD lets you hold runners through pullbacks; trailing punishes you for it.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_44_q: Does open equity matter for EOD drawdown?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_44_a: Yes - open equity matters for the daily loss limit and intraday account-termination logic, but not for the EOD drawdown calculation itself. Open equity at end-of-day is rolled into the next day's starting balance after positions close (which can't happen on evaluation accounts because overnight is banned).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_45_q: Does Earn2Trade have trailing drawdown on any account type?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_45_a: No. Earn2Trade applies End-of-Day drawdown to evaluation, LiveSim, and Live accounts at every size. There is no intraday trailing model anywhere in the product line. Older third-party blog posts that describe Earn2Trade as having a trailing-drawdown variant are out of date - confirm against help.earn2trade.com if in doubt.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_46_q: Is the drawdown the same in evaluation and on the funded LiveSim account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_46_a: Yes - both evaluation and LiveSim use EOD drawdown with the same dollar amount as the corresponding evaluation tier. This is by design, so the rules don't change when you cross from "evaluating" to "funded LiveSim."
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_consistency_heading: What Are Earn2Trade's Consistency Rule and Prohibited Trading Conduct?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_47_q: What is the Maintain Consistency rule?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_47_a: No single trading day can account for 30% or more of your total cumulative PnL during the evaluation. Designed to prevent passing on a single lucky session. Applies to TCP and Gauntlet Mini evaluations only - not to LiveSim or Live funded accounts.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_48_q: What happens if I break the consistency rule?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_48_a: You don't fail. You just need to keep trading and add more profit until that big day represents less than 30% of your cumulative profits. Example: a $1,200 single-day profit means you need at least $4,000 total profit before you can pass ($1,200 ÷ 0.30 = $4,000).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_49_q: Does the consistency rule apply to losing days too?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_49_a: Yes - daily PnL counts both directions toward the 30% rule. A massive losing day that's 30%+ of your absolute PnL counts. Most traders only encounter the rule via outsized winning days.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_50_q: Is the consistency rule the same as the 50% rule on other firms?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_50_a: No - Earn2Trade's threshold is tighter at 30%, vs Topstep's payout-time consistency check. Apex doesn't have a hard consistency rule on evaluation. Earn2Trade's rule is one of the stricter consistency requirements in the futures-prop industry.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_51_q: Does the consistency rule apply once I'm funded?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_51_a: No. LiveSim and Live funded accounts have no consistency rule. The rule is purely an evaluation gate.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_52_a: A self-regulation rule that limits the number of contracts you can open based on your current account balance / profit level. The idea: you "earn" the right to size up by being green. Encourages disciplined sizing rather than maxing out from day one.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_53_q: How does the Progression Ladder work on a $50K account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_53_a: On a $50,000 account: 2 contracts at start. Above $1,500-$2,000 in profits: 4 contracts. Above $2,000 in profits: 6 contracts (the max for the $50K tier).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_54_q: What's the maximum contract count on each tier?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_54_a: TCP25: 3 contracts max. TCP50/GAU50: 6. TCP100/GAU100: 12. GAU150: 15. GAU200: 16. Higher TCP scaling stages have proportionally larger max sizing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_55_q: How are micro contracts counted toward the Progression Ladder?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_55_a: Up to 10 micros count as 1 ladder contract. Eligible micros include MES, MNQ, MYM, M2K, MGC, MCL, M6E, MHG, M6B. Example: if your ladder allows 3 contracts you could trade 3 ES, or 2 ES + 10 MES, or 1 ES + 20 MES, or 30 MES.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_56_q: What happens if I exceed the Progression Ladder?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_56_a: Account is blocked from trading for the rest of that day. The block is automatically lifted at next market close - you don't have to reset, you just can't trade for the remainder of the day. Continue normally next session.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_57_a: Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines on automated trading. Many PickMyTrade customers use automation on their Earn2Trade accounts — a small amount of risk is involved.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_58_q: Is copy trading allowed across multiple accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_58_a: Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines on copy trading and multi-account setups. PickMyTrade supports one alert firing to multiple connected accounts simultaneously with per-account quantity multipliers.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_59_a: Spoofing, layering, latency arbitrage, exploiting platform errors, trading unrealistic contract volumes, sharing accounts, third-party trading, geo-blocking circumvention, account collusion, and any non-market trading methods. Standard prop firm prohibitions, applied with active enforcement.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_60_q: What are the consequences of breaking a rule?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_60_a: Depending on severity: warnings, deletion of trade data, account reset, or permanent account closure. Pattern violations and willful manipulation get permanent bans. Accidental first-time issues sometimes get warnings.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_scaling_heading: How Does Account Scaling Work on Earn2Trade's TCP?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_61_q: How does the TCP scaling plan work?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_61_a: After you pass the evaluation, your funded account scales up automatically each time you hit the profit target for the current stage and withdraw your profit share. Each stage has a defined target. Hit it, withdraw, advance to a fresh, larger account with more room.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_62_a: $25K - $50K - $100K - $200K. Maximum reachable on TCP25 is $200K. Profit targets at each stage roughly track the 6%-10% range; specific dollar amounts increase with size.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_64_a: $100K - $150K - $200K - $400K. Same $400K cap as TCP50, with a $150K intermediate stage instead of TCP50's smaller stages.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_65_q: Do I need to take a new evaluation to scale up on TCP?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_65_a: No. Scaling is automatic - once you hit the stage's profit target and withdraw, you advance. This is the headline feature of TCP versus most futures prop firms where you'd need to pass another challenge to access a bigger account.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_66_q: Can I skip a TCP stage?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_66_a: No. You progress one stage at a time. Each stage requires its own profit target hit + withdrawal before advancing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_67_q: Does scaling reset my drawdown room?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_67_a: Yes - moving to a larger account gives you a fresh balance with the new stage's drawdown amount. The old account closes when you advance.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_68_q: What if I bust drawdown mid-scaling?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_68_a: The current stage account closes. To continue you'd need to take a fresh evaluation - TCP scaling does not include free re-funding after a bust. The free monthly reset only applies during the evaluation phase.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_69_q: How long does each TCP scaling stage take?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_69_a: No time limit. You hit the target when you hit it. There's no minimum-day requirement on funded accounts (the 10-day rule is evaluation-only). In practice, traders take weeks to months per stage depending on consistency.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_70_q: Does the Gauntlet Mini have any scaling?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_70_a: No formal scaling structure. The Gauntlet Mini gives you a single funded account at the size you chose ($50K-$200K). To get a larger account post-funding you'd need to take a new evaluation. TCP is the path for built-in scaling.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_funded_heading: What's the Difference Between Earn2Trade's Live and LiveSim Funded Accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_71_q: What's the difference between Live and LiveSim accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_71_a: Live accounts execute real orders against the CME using the prop firm's actual capital - your fills hit the real market. LiveSim accounts are simulated against live market data - your "fills" don't reach the exchange but you still get paid real profit shares from the firm. LiveSim is faster to set up; Live takes longer to spin up because of broker registration. Both Live and LiveSim use the same End-of-Day drawdown model - Earn2Trade does not switch to a trailing model when you go Live.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_72_q: Why do most traders pick LiveSim over Live?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_72_a: Anecdotally, the majority of funded Earn2Trade traders pick LiveSim - though Earn2Trade does not publish an official Live-vs-LiveSim split. Reasons: ~2-day setup vs ~10-day setup, no monthly exchange data fees, no broker registration paperwork, and one-time activation fee deducted from first payout rather than billed monthly. The trade-off is simulated execution - but for retail-size futures trading, the practical difference is small.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_73_q: Is LiveSim "real" funding if it's simulated?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_73_a: Yes from a payout standpoint - Helios/Appius pay you real US dollars on profitable LiveSim trading. The simulation is on the order routing side. This is standard prop firm practice industry-wide and doesn't make the payouts any less real.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_74_q: How long does Live account setup take?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_74_a: Up to 10 business days because the prop firm needs to register you with the brokerage, complete CME exchange agreements, and provision real-money infrastructure.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_75_q: How long does LiveSim setup take?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_75_a: As fast as 2 business days. No brokerage registration needed. You can start trading the same week you accept the funding offer.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_76_q: Can I switch from LiveSim to Live later?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_76_a: Yes - typically once you hit the maximum withdrawal cap on LiveSim. The transition involves the broker registration steps that you'd skipped initially.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_77_q: Does the consistency rule apply on funded accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_77_a: No. Live and LiveSim funded accounts have no consistency rule and no minimum trading days. The rules that applied during evaluation relax once you're funded.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_78_q: Are overnight positions allowed on funded accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_78_a: Yes, on Live and LiveSim funded accounts you can hold overnight, with the requirement of at least one new unique position per week to keep the account active. Big difference from the evaluation phase where overnights are banned.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_79_q: Is there a withdrawal cap on LiveSim?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_79_a: Yes - LiveSim accounts have per-withdrawal caps that vary by account size and program. The cap is generally tied to the stage's profit target minus the 20% firm share. Specific dollar amounts shift with policy updates, so verify the current LiveSim payout cap against help.earn2trade.com or the funded-trader agreement Helios/Appius send you. Live accounts have looser withdrawal limits.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_80_q: Does Earn2Trade close inactive funded accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_80_a: Yes. Funded accounts require at least one new unique position per week. Extended inactivity triggers account closure. Specific timing varies by Helios/Appius funded trader agreement.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_payouts_heading: How Do Earn2Trade Payouts and Withdrawals Work?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_81_q: What's the profit split on Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_81_a: 80/20 in your favor on every funded account. You keep 80%, the prop firm keeps 20%. There is no scaling toward 100% on Earn2Trade - the split stays flat regardless of cumulative payouts or how far you climb the TCP scaling ladder. Lower than Apex's 90%, but Earn2Trade includes built-in account-size scaling and free monthly resets in exchange.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_82_a: Once a week, every Wednesday. Submit your withdrawal request to the prop firm by 2:00 PM CT Friday to be paid the following Wednesday. Miss the Friday cutoff and you wait another week.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_83_a: $100 net minimum on both Live and LiveSim accounts. The first withdrawal needs at least $239 in profits if you're a non-professional CME LiveSim trader, because the $139 activation fee is deducted from that first payout.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_84_q: Are there withdrawal restrictions or holding periods?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_84_a: No restrictions on when you can withdraw - once funded, you can request payouts anytime profits clear the minimum threshold. No "wait 14 days," no "do 5 winning days first" - Earn2Trade is unusually flexible here.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_85_a: Rise (which supports ACH, Wise, and local bank rails underneath) and direct crypto are the two documented payout channels. Method depends on your country - the prop firm assigns you a route based on geography and regulatory fit. Deel and Bayzat are not Earn2Trade payout providers; older summaries that list them are inaccurate.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_86_a: Rise charges a small fixed or percentage fee per their published schedule, and Earn2Trade has historically documented that the standard $10 Rise fee is waived on withdrawals above $500. Direct crypto withdrawals also carry a small network/processing fee. Specific rate cards change - verify current fees with Helios/Appius or in the Rise dashboard before relying on a precise number. Bank-side and crypto-network fees may apply on top.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_87_q: How long does the payout take after Wednesday processing?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_87_a: ACH: 3-5 business days (slowest). Bank wire: 1-2 business days. PayPal: hours after processing. Crypto: minutes to hours depending on network. Wise/SWIFT international: 2-5 business days.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_88_q: Is the activation fee paid upfront anymore?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_88_a: No - Earn2Trade scrapped upfront activation fees in 2025. The $139 setup fee for non-professional CME status LiveSim is now deducted from your first profit withdrawal only. If you never make a profit withdrawal, you never pay the fee.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_89_q: Can I withdraw to a third-party bank account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_89_a: No. The KYC framework requires payouts to a bank account / crypto wallet in your name. Third-party transfers are not supported.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_90_q: What forms do I need to submit before my first payout?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_90_a: US traders: W-9. Non-US traders: W-8BEN with Foreign Tax Identifying Number (FTIN). Plus standard KYC: government-issued ID, proof of address, in some cases a selfie verification.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_91_q: Are payouts capped on funded accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_91_a: LiveSim has per-withdrawal caps that vary by account size and program. The cap is typically anchored to the stage's profit target minus the 20% firm share. Specific dollar amounts shift with policy updates - confirm the current cap against the funded-trader agreement from Helios/Appius. Live accounts have looser limits once you've built a track record.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_92_q: Why does my first withdrawal need $239 minimum?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_92_a: $100 minimum withdrawal + $139 activation fee deducted = $239 minimum profit needed for your first payout (non-professional CME LiveSim only). Subsequent withdrawals just need the $100 minimum.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_93_q: Are there US states/territories where Rise can't pay?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_93_a: Yes - Rise has restrictions in certain US states and territories due to state-specific regulatory requirements. Check Earn2Trade's payout-update help article for the current list before purchasing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_94_q: Do US traders get a 1099 from Earn2Trade or Helios?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_94_a: Yes - Helios issues a 1099-NEC (non-employee compensation) for US traders who received $600+ in payouts during the calendar year. Reported on Schedule C as contractor income. Below $600 you still owe tax but no 1099 is issued.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_platforms_heading: Which Platforms and Data Feeds Does Earn2Trade Support?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_95_q: What trading platforms does Earn2Trade support?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_95_a: Tradovate, NinjaTrader, Finamark, Rithmic R|Trader (the bare-metal Rithmic frontend), and TradingView - which Earn2Trade added as a directly supported platform in March 2026. Earn2Trade officially recommends NinjaTrader for charting depth, but Tradovate and TradingView are heavily used by traders who want browser-based access or webhook integrations.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_96_q: What is Rithmic and why is it important on Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_96_a: Rithmic is the underlying market data and order routing infrastructure for Earn2Trade evaluation accounts. After purchase you'll receive a "Rithmic Data Feed Credentials Created" email with your login. Plug those credentials into NinjaTrader, R|Trader, or any Rithmic-compatible platform.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_97_a: Yes - Earn2Trade includes a free NinjaTrader and/or Finamark license with active subscriptions, plus complimentary access to Journalytix journaling software. The license is tied to your Earn2Trade subscription period.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_98_a: Finamark is a browser-based futures trading platform supported as one of Earn2Trade's connection options. Connects to Rithmic for data and order routing. Lighter than NinjaTrader but functional for retail futures workflows.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_99_q: Can I use Tradovate with Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_99_a: Yes - Tradovate is a supported platform on Earn2Trade evaluations and funded accounts. Tradovate's web/mobile/desktop clients all work; you authenticate with your Earn2Trade-issued Tradovate credentials.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_100_q: Can I use TradingView with Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_100_a: Yes. Earn2Trade added TradingView as a directly supported platform in March 2026 - you can chart and route orders to your Earn2Trade account from inside TradingView. Many traders still pair TradingView with Tradovate-hosted Earn2Trade accounts and a webhook bridge (such as PickMyTrade) when they want alert-driven execution, but native TradingView access is now part of the Earn2Trade platform lineup.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_101_q: Can I use SierraChart with Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_101_a: Yes - SierraChart connects to the Rithmic data feed Earn2Trade provides. SierraChart isn't bundled like NinjaTrader, so you'd need a paid SierraChart license, but the Rithmic credentials work natively in SierraChart.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_102_q: Can I use Quantower with Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_102_a: Quantower supports Rithmic - so the data feed will connect - but it's not on Earn2Trade's officially-listed platform set. Verify with Earn2Trade support before relying on it for evaluation execution.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_103_q: How do I set up my Earn2Trade Rithmic data feed?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_103_a: After purchase, look for the "Rithmic Data Feed Credentials Created" email. Accept the Rithmic exchange agreements (CME, COMEX, NYMEX, CBOT). Plug the username/password into NinjaTrader's Rithmic connection (or whichever supported platform you chose).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_104_q: Why does my Rithmic connection fail in NinjaTrader?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_104_a: Most common: exchange agreements not yet accepted (check Rithmic's portal), wrong server (Earn2Trade routes to specific Rithmic gateways), or NinjaTrader's Rithmic plugin not installed. Earn2Trade's help center has a step-by-step setup article.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_105_q: Can I use both Rithmic and Tradovate at the same time?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_105_a: In NinjaTrader yes - multiple connections can run simultaneously. But each Earn2Trade account is on one platform - your evaluation account is either Rithmic-routed or Tradovate-routed, not both. Pick one at signup.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_106_q: What are the data fees on funded accounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_106_a: During evaluation: included for non-professional CME status (no extra cost). On funded LiveSim non-professional: one-time $139 fee deducted from first withdrawal. Funded Live (Rithmic): $140/month per exchange. Funded Live (NinjaTrader): $156/month per exchange. Professional CME status traders pay $140/month per exchange across the board.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_107_a: CME's classification for retail traders not employed by a financial firm. Most retail Earn2Trade users are non-professional, which qualifies them for the cheaper data fee structure ($139 one-time vs $140/month per exchange).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_108_q: Does Earn2Trade have a mobile app?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_108_a: Earn2Trade itself doesn't ship a dedicated mobile app, but if you trade through Tradovate you get the official Tradovate iOS/Android apps for free. NinjaTrader's mobile app and Finamark's responsive web client also cover mobile use cases.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_automation_heading: Does Earn2Trade Allow Automated Trading via TradingView and PickMyTrade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_109_a: PickMyTrade supports both Tradovate and Rithmic broker connections, which means it is technically compatible with Earn2Trade accounts running on either platform. To connect a Tradovate-based Earn2Trade account, go to pickmytrade.trade. For a Rithmic-based Earn2Trade account, go to pickmytrade.io. Many PickMyTrade customers use automation on their Earn2Trade accounts — a small amount of risk is involved, so always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines before deploying automation.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_110_a: Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines. Many PickMyTrade customers use automation on their Earn2Trade accounts — a small amount of risk is involved. PickMyTrade supports both Tradovate and Rithmic connections for Earn2Trade accounts.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_111_q: Can I use TradingView alerts with Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_111_a: Since March 2026, TradingView is a directly supported platform on Earn2Trade. In PickMyTrade, go to Generate Alert to create your alert — you will receive a JSON payload and a webhook URL. Paste the JSON into the TradingView alert message box and paste the webhook URL into the TradingView webhook field. For Tradovate-based Earn2Trade accounts, connect at pickmytrade.trade. For Rithmic-based accounts, connect at pickmytrade.io. Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_112_q: Is copy trading between my own accounts allowed?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_112_a: Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines on multi-account trading. PickMyTrade supports one alert firing to multiple connected accounts simultaneously with per-account quantity multipliers.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_113_q: Can I use a VPS on Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_113_a: A VPS for running NinjaTrader stably is generally fine — that's no different from running it on your home PC. Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines on what software may be run on it.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_114_q: Can PickMyTrade connect to Earn2Trade directly?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_114_a: PickMyTrade connects at the broker level — not directly to Earn2Trade. For Tradovate-based Earn2Trade accounts, connect at pickmytrade.trade. For Rithmic-based accounts, connect at pickmytrade.io. In PickMyTrade, go to Generate Alert to create your alert — you will receive a JSON payload and a webhook URL. Paste the JSON into the TradingView alert message box and paste the webhook URL into the TradingView webhook field.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_115_q: What does PickMyTrade cost and how does it help?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_115_a: $50/month per broker connection across all your prop accounts. PMT is the no-code webhook bridge between TradingView (or any alerting tool) and supported brokers including Tradovate and Rithmic. For Tradovate-based Earn2Trade accounts, connect at pickmytrade.trade. For Rithmic-based accounts, connect at pickmytrade.io. Many PickMyTrade customers use automation on their Earn2Trade accounts — always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_education_heading: What Education, Bootcamp, and Crash Course Resources Does Earn2Trade Offer?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_116_a: Active TCP and Gauntlet Mini subscribers get access to Earn2Trade's educational catalog: the Beginner Crash Course (60 short videos), full futures education library, plus Journalytix journaling software. Bootcamp is the deeper paid program with mentorship.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_117_q: What is the Beginner Crash Course?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_117_a: 60 short videos (6-10 minutes each) covering market mechanics, market conditions, risk management, and technical trading basics. Free with any active TCP or Gauntlet Mini examination subscription. Sold standalone at roughly $249, with a lifetime-access tier around $199.20 in past promotional cycles. Aimed at traders new to futures.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_118_a: A 4-month structured course bundling video lessons, weekly live group webinars, personalized mentorship sessions, simulator practice, and the Gauntlet examination at the end. One-time payment of approximately $2,499.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_119_q: Should I take Bootcamp or just buy a TCP/Gauntlet Mini?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_119_a: If you're new to futures and want a structured curriculum + accountability, Bootcamp's ~$2,499 is competitive with private trading mentorships. If you have trading experience, the standalone TCP or Gauntlet Mini at roughly $90-$350/month is much cheaper and gets you to a funded account faster.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_120_a: Yes - complimentary Journalytix journaling software access during your active TCP/Gauntlet Mini subscription. Helps you log trades, analyze patterns, and reflect on performance.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_121_a: Bootcamp includes weekly group webinars and individual mentorship sessions. Standard TCP/Gauntlet Mini subscriptions don't include the structured webinar curriculum, though Earn2Trade's blog and YouTube put out regular content.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_122_a: No traditional free trial. The cheapest path is to grab a promo code (often 30-60% off the first 1-2 months) and start a TCP25 at the discounted rate. The Beginner Crash Course is free without subscription on certain Earn2Trade pages.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_123_q: Does education access continue after I cancel?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_123_a: No - canceling your subscription terminates access to evaluation accounts, simulator, and educational material. Earn2Trade can't reinstate canceled subscriptions for technical reasons. Plan to download or note anything important before canceling.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_124_q: Does Bootcamp guarantee passing the Gauntlet?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_124_a: No - Bootcamp gives you the curriculum, mentorship, and Gauntlet attempt. The same rules apply to the Gauntlet examination as to the Gauntlet Mini. Earn2Trade does not publish a separate pass-rate stat for Bootcamp.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_125_q: Is there a coaching feature like Topstep's Coach T?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_125_a: No AI-coach equivalent. Earn2Trade's coaching is human-led via Bootcamp mentorship. Standard TCP/Gauntlet Mini subscribers don't get assigned coaches; they get curriculum + journaling + community.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_products_heading: What Products, Trading Hours, and Instruments Can You Trade on Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_126_q: What can I trade on Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_126_a: Futures only, on the four CME Group exchanges: CME, COMEX, NYMEX, and CBOT. No stocks, no options, no spot forex, no crypto, no CFDs. Pure futures shop.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_127_q: What futures contracts can I trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_127_a: Equity index (ES, NQ, YM, RTY plus micros MES/MNQ/MYM/M2K), energy (CL, NG plus MCL), metals (GC, SI plus MGC), rates (ZB, ZN, ZF, ZT), currencies (6E, 6B, 6J plus M6E/M6B), agricultural (ZC, ZS, ZW), softs, and Bitcoin micros (MBT subject to current allowance). The full CME/CBOT/NYMEX/COMEX product slate.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_128_a: Yes - and micros get a favorable progression-ladder treatment (10 micros = 1 contract for ladder purposes). MES, MNQ, MYM, M2K, MGC, MCL, M6E, MHG, M6B all qualify. Micros are how new traders survive the EOD drawdown while learning sizing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_129_q: Can I trade options on futures?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_129_a: No. Options on futures are not supported on Earn2Trade evaluations or funded accounts. Only outright futures contracts.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_130_a: Outright legs only. Calendar spreads or inter-product spreads as exchange-defined products are generally not supported on retail prop infrastructure. Confirm with Earn2Trade support if you have a specific spread strategy.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_131_a: CME hours: Sunday 5:00 PM CT through Friday 4:00 PM CT, with daily 60-minute maintenance breaks. Earn2Trade evaluation accounts force a 3:50 PM CT daily flatten - all positions closed by then.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_132_q: When must I close positions on the evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_132_a: 3:50 PM CT every trading day. No overnight holds during TCP or Gauntlet Mini evaluation. Auto-flatten kicks in at 3:50 if you haven't closed manually.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_133_q: Can I trade on US holidays?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_133_a: Whenever the underlying CME exchange is open - Earn2Trade follows CME's calendar. Some holidays have early closes; some products close earlier than others (cattle futures close earlier than ES). Plan around the exchange's session schedule.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_134_a: Yes - Earn2Trade has no news-trading restriction. Trade FOMC, NFP, CPI, ECB, all of it. This is friendlier than Topstep (which restricts max position into news) and similar to Apex.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_135_a: Yes - discretionary scalping is permitted. The lines are: no HFT/sub-second algorithmic execution, no spoofing, no platform exploits. Standard manual scalping with 10s-30s holds is fine.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_fees_heading: What Are Earn2Trade's Fees, Reset Costs, Refunds, and Discounts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_136_q: How much does each Earn2Trade plan cost monthly?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_136_a: TCP25 / GAU25: ~$90/month (often closer to $75 with 50% promo discounts). TCP50 / GAU50: ~$170/month. TCP100 / GAU100: ~$200-$250/month. GAU150: ~$300/month. GAU200: ~$350/month. Earlier $150/month TCP25 pricing has lapsed. Pricing changes with promotional cycles - check Earn2Trade's purchase page for current rates.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_137_a: Yes - one free reset is included every time your monthly subscription is rebilled. As long as you stay subscribed, you get one fresh restart per billing cycle. Big advantage versus Apex's pay-per-reset model.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_138_q: What's the cost of a paid reset?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_138_a: Effective May 1, 2025: TCP25/TCP50/GAU50 reset prices are dynamic with promotions (kept below new-subscription cost). Larger accounts have fixed pricing - TCP100: $100. GAU100: $100. GAU150: $130. GAU200: $155. Paid resets are extra (above the included free monthly reset).
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_139_a: No refunds. Earn2Trade calls their products "irrevocable" - once paid, you don't get money back, including on automated subscription renewals. Cancel before the next billing date to avoid being charged.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_140_q: How do I cancel my subscription?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_140_a: Cancel via your Earn2Trade dashboard before the next billing date. Once canceled, you lose access to evaluation accounts, simulator, and educational material immediately - and Earn2Trade cannot reinstate the same evaluation due to technical reasons. So plan accordingly.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_141_a: Yes - $139 one-time for non-professional CME status LiveSim. As of 2025 it's no longer charged upfront - deducted from your first profit withdrawal only. If you don't withdraw profits, you don't pay it.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_142_a: Yes - Earn2Trade runs frequent promo codes (often 30%, 50%, or 60% off first months). Codes change monthly and around seasonal events. Check coupon aggregators or Earn2Trade's email list before purchasing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_143_q: Is the discount only for the first month or recurring?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_143_a: Most promo codes apply to the first 1-2 months only. Some longer-term codes exist (e.g. INBOX60X12 has been spotted as 12-month 60% off in past cycles), but those are rarer. Standard pricing kicks in after the promo period.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_144_a: For US traders treating prop trading as a business, subscription fees, reset fees, activation fees, education courses, and trading software (PickMyTrade, journaling tools, VPS) generally qualify as Schedule C business expenses. Consult a CPA for your specific situation.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_145_a: No. Once a reset is purchased and applied, it's not refundable. Same irrevocable-purchase policy as the main subscription.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_countries_heading: What Are Earn2Trade's Country Restrictions, KYC, and Tax Form Requirements?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_146_a: Most countries globally are eligible. Restricted countries (due to OFAC sanctions, KYC/AML constraints, or data-feed provider rules) include: Afghanistan, Albania, Azerbaijan, Burma (Myanmar), Central African Republic, Cuba, Gibraltar, Iran, Iraq, Kenya, Libya, Mali, Nauru, Nigeria, North Korea, Pakistan, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Venezuela, and Yemen. Palestine is also unsupported by the data feed provider. The list shifts with policy changes - verify your country on the purchase page before subscribing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_147_q: Do I need to be a US citizen to get funded?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_147_a: No - Earn2Trade has historically been one of the better futures props for non-US traders. Non-US citizens submit a W-8BEN (with FTIN) instead of a W-9. Routing may be through Appius (UK partner) instead of Helios depending on geography.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_148_q: Are there US states/territories restricted from payouts?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_148_a: Yes - Rise (Earn2Trade's primary US payout method) doesn't support certain US locations due to state-level regulations. Check the help center's "Payout Update for Traders in Certain U.S. States and Territories" article for the current list before purchasing.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_149_a: IRS form for non-US individuals certifying foreign tax status. Required before your first payout if you're outside the US. Includes your country of residence and, where applicable, an FTIN (Foreign Tax Identifying Number). Whether an FTIN is required is country- and treaty-dependent - not universal. Determines withholding rates under any applicable tax treaty.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_150_a: Foreign Tax Identifying Number - your home country's equivalent of an SSN/EIN. Required on the W-8BEN. India's PAN, UK's UTR, EU national tax IDs, etc. all qualify.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_151_q: What if my country is added to the sanctions list mid-evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_151_a: If your country is newly sanctioned during your evaluation, you can't continue or reset. Purchases or resets from newly-sanctioned countries are not refunded - Earn2Trade holds a no-refund policy on this scenario too.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_152_q: What's the minimum age to trade with Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_152_a: 18 years old. Standard for retail prop firms.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_153_q: Does Earn2Trade send tax forms to international traders?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_153_a: Generally no - non-US traders don't get a 1099. You're responsible for reporting prop trading income in your country of residence. The W-8BEN you submitted establishes your non-US tax status with the prop firm; your domestic tax filing is on you.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_154_q: Are payouts to crypto wallets supported internationally?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_154_a: Yes - direct crypto withdrawals are one of the two documented payout channels (Rise being the other), with a small network/processing fee. Useful for international traders in countries where Rise's local bank rails have weaker infrastructure.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_155_q: Can I change my country of residence on my account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_155_a: Yes, but it triggers KYC re-verification - and can change your routing partner (Helios vs Appius) and your payout method. Contact Earn2Trade support to initiate the country change rather than trying to do it through the dashboard alone.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_compare_heading: How Does Earn2Trade Compare to Other Prop Firms?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_156_q: Earn2Trade vs Topstep - which is better?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_156_a: Topstep is better for traders who want the largest community and a polished proprietary platform (TopstepX). Earn2Trade is better for traders who want a defined scaling path to $400K, the friendlier EOD drawdown, news trading allowance, and education-bundled subscriptions. Topstep's profit split (90/10 for new traders) edges Earn2Trade's 80/20.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_157_q: Earn2Trade vs Apex Trader Funding - which is better?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_157_a: Apex wins on profit split (90% vs 80%), one-time eval fees vs monthly, no consistency rule on evaluation, and explicit automation friendliness (EAs allowed). Earn2Trade wins on built-in scaling to $400K with no new evaluations needed, free monthly resets, included education, and EOD drawdown across every account type (Apex offers EOD only on certain account variants). Anecdotal community data suggests Apex has a higher first-attempt pass rate, but Earn2Trade does not publish official pass-rate figures.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_158_q: Earn2Trade vs MyFundedFutures (MFFU) - which is better?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_158_a: MFFU has multiple plan tiers, friendlier to automation, faster first payout (5 winning days), and 100% retention on first $10K. Earn2Trade wins on built-in scaling, education depth, and decade-long track record. Both have similar evaluation difficulty.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_159_q: Earn2Trade vs Tradeify - which is better?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_159_a: Tradeify is newer (2023) but rapidly grown — known for Tradeify Elite Live (real-money trading after $80K cumulative payouts). Earn2Trade is the older, more established option with a longer track record. Both support PickMyTrade connections via Tradovate and Rithmic. Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines on automation.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_160_q: Why is Earn2Trade's profit split lower than competitors?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_160_a: Trade-offs: Earn2Trade gives you free monthly resets (Apex charges per reset), education bundled in (Apex doesn't include curriculum), built-in scaling to $400K with no new evaluations (Apex caps at $300K and requires fresh evals to grow), and a longer-running, well-known brand. The 80/20 split is the price for those features.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_161_q: Which futures prop firm has the easiest evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_161_a: Hard to rank precisely because most firms don't publish audited pass rates. Community-reported figures suggest Apex has the highest first-attempt pass rate, with MFFU and Tradeify roughly comparable. Earn2Trade does not publish a pass-rate statistic, but the 30% consistency rule plus the 10-day minimum tend to make the evaluation feel stricter than competitors. Pass rate alone isn't the full picture - payout reliability and post-funding rules matter more long term.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_162_q: Which futures prop firm pays out fastest?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_162_a: MFFU and Apex tend to be quickest on first payout. Earn2Trade's weekly Wednesday cycle is consistent, but the friction is the Friday 2PM CT cutoff plus the activation-fee deduction on first payout. After first payout, Earn2Trade is roughly comparable to peers.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_163_q: Why do some traders prefer Earn2Trade over flashier newer firms?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_163_a: Decade-long track record (most prop firms launched in 2020-2024). Survived the 2024-2025 prop firm collapse wave. Affiliated funded operator (Helios) under shared ownership for nearly as long. Real education bundle. The TCP scaling structure is genuinely unique. Customer support is consistently praised on Trustpilot. For "boring reliability," Earn2Trade is a known quantity.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_164_a: Yes - the bundled education, structured Bootcamp option, friendlier EOD drawdown, and free monthly resets make it more beginner-friendly than Apex (which assumes you already know how to trade). The evaluation is still strict thanks to the 30% consistency rule, but at least you have a curriculum to lean on.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_165_q: Is Earn2Trade good for advanced traders?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_165_a: For advanced traders who value scaling without re-evaluation: yes. PickMyTrade supports Tradovate and Rithmic connections for Earn2Trade accounts. Always check Earn2Trade's official website for their current compliance guidelines before deploying automation.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_troubleshooting_heading: What Are the Most Common Reasons Traders Fail Earn2Trade?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_166_q: Why did my evaluation account fail unexpectedly?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_166_a: Most common reasons: hit the daily loss limit, busted the EOD drawdown floor at end-of-day close, exceeded the Progression Ladder contract count (account blocked for the day, not failed but feels the same), or held a position past 3:50 PM CT. The dashboard shows the specific trigger.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_167_q: My account got "blocked" instead of failed - what's the difference?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_167_a: "Blocked" usually means a Progression Ladder violation - your account is locked for the rest of the trading day but automatically unlocks at next market close. You don't need to reset. "Failed" means a hard rule breach (drawdown bust, daily loss hit) - you'd need to reset to continue.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_168_q: Why does my Earn2Trade dashboard show different P&L than NinjaTrader?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_168_a: Earn2Trade's dashboard updates may lag the platform during heavy load. Most differences trace to commissions, exchange fees, or the dashboard not yet processing your most recent fills. If the gap is sustained or larger than commissions can explain, contact support with timestamps and screenshots.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_169_q: My Rithmic data feed disconnected - what do I do?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_169_a: Reconnect via your trading platform's connection panel. If repeated, check Rithmic's status page for outages. If outage-related losses occurred, document timestamps/screenshots and email support - Earn2Trade reviews outage cases individually.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_170_q: I passed but didn't receive my funding offer - what now?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_170_a: Funding offers come from Helios or Appius (depending on geography), not directly from Earn2Trade. Email checks: spam folder, "Helios Trader Group" or "Appius Trading" sender names. If 5+ business days have passed without contact, message Earn2Trade support to escalate.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_171_q: My first withdrawal got denied - why?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_171_a: Most common: didn't have $239+ in profit ($100 minimum + $139 activation fee), KYC mismatch (name/address inconsistency), W-9 or W-8BEN not submitted, or your country's payout method wasn't yet provisioned. Resolve each item with support and re-request.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_172_q: Why is my LiveSim performance different from Live?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_172_a: LiveSim uses a simulated execution engine against live data. Real Live accounts route to the CME - slippage, queue position, partial fills can differ. The most-reported gap is small but consistent ($X cheaper or more expensive average fills). For most retail-size trading, the difference is sub-$50 per session.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_173_q: I held past 3:50 PM CT by accident - am I done?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_173_a: The auto-flatten will close the position at 3:50. The closure itself is a rule reminder rather than an automatic fail. If the auto-flatten fill was poor enough to bust drawdown or daily loss, that bust is what fails the account - not the late hold itself. Plan around the 3:50 cutoff to avoid surprises.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_174_q: My consistency rule violation triggered at the worst time - am I doomed?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_174_a: Not doomed. The rule doesn't fail you - it just blocks the pass until you trade more. Calculate: highest day's profit ÷ 0.30 = total profit needed. Keep trading conservatively to add to the total without breaking other rules.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_175_q: How do I contact Earn2Trade support?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_175_a: In-dashboard chat is the fastest. Email support is also available via the help center. Trustpilot reviews consistently mention quick response times - specific support agents (Ikbal, Ayush, Ysmarlin) are mentioned by name in many reviews.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_176_q: What if Earn2Trade closes my account for prohibited conduct?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_176_a: Severity-based: warnings for first-time accidental issues, account resets for moderate violations, permanent closures for pattern violations or willful manipulation. No refunds on closure. Appeal via support with documentation if you believe the decision was incorrect.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_177_q: Why is my Tradovate connection failing for my Earn2Trade account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_177_a: Most common: wrong username (Earn2Trade-issued Tradovate login differs from a personal Tradovate account), expired credentials after subscription lapse, or Tradovate maintenance windows. Verify in your Earn2Trade dashboard that Tradovate is the platform you selected, then re-authenticate.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_178_q: Can I set trading time restrictions in PickMyTrade for my Earn2Trade account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_178_a: PickMyTrade includes a Trading Time feature available across all supported broker connections. You can configure specific active trading windows with start and end times (24-hour ET format). Any TradingView alerts received outside your configured hours are automatically rejected — no new trades are placed. Existing open positions remain active. Settings can be applied to specific accounts or all accounts at once. Full guide: https://docs.pickmytrade.io/docs/trading-time-settings/ For Tradovate accounts, PickMyTrade also integrates with ForexFactory to automatically pause trading before and after scheduled news events — it can close open positions and cancel pending limit/stop orders during news windows. Tradovate Trading Time guide: https://docs.pickmytrade.trade/docs/trading-time-settings/
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_gap_earn2trade_heading: What's New for Earn2Trade KYC, Funding, Automation, and Policies?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_179_q: Who is Kronos Proprietary Trading and why might they fund me instead of Helios?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_179_a: Kronos Proprietary Trading is one of Earn2Trade's funding partners alongside Helios Trading Partners and Appius Trading Limited. When you pass the Trader Career Path or Gauntlet Mini, your guaranteed funding offer comes from one of these partner firms, and which one depends on factors like your account type and region rather than anything you choose. All of them honor the same Earn2Trade rules, profit split, and payout terms, so the practical experience is the same regardless of which entity's name appears on your funded-trader agreement. Verify on Earn2Trade's official site, as partner firms can change over time.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_180_q: Can I get evaluated and funded before I complete the 10 trading days if I hit the profit goal early?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_180_a: No. Both the Trader Career Path and the Gauntlet Mini require a minimum of 10 trading days, and hitting your profit target sooner does not waive that requirement. You simply keep trading until you reach the 10th qualifying day, then your account is reviewed for funding. There is no end time limit, so reaching the target early just means you wait out the remaining days while staying inside the rules. Verify current rules on Earn2Trade's Help Center.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_181_q: How do I calculate exactly how much total profit I need so one big day doesn't break the 30% consistency rule?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_181_a: Divide your single best day's profit by 0.30 to get the minimum total profit you need on the account. For example, a $1,200 best day requires at least $4,000 in total profit so that day stays under 30% of the total. A day that exceeds the threshold does not fail you on the spot; it just means you must keep trading and adding profit on other days until the ratio falls back into range. Verify the live threshold on Earn2Trade's Help Center, as consistency percentages can change.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_182_q: What documents do I need for KYC, and when do I have to submit them?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_182_a: Earn2Trade requires a government-issued photo ID, and depending on your situation you may also be asked for proof of address and a selfie verification. You upload ID information at account setup, but full KYC and the signed funded-trader agreement are completed after you pass your evaluation and before your funded account is activated. Having clear, in-date documents ready avoids delays in getting your LiveSim or Live account turned on. Verify the current document list on Earn2Trade's official site.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_183_q: Is there a knowledge quiz I have to pass before I can start the evaluation?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_183_a: Yes. As part of onboarding, Earn2Trade includes a multiple-choice knowledge check (around 50 questions) and you generally need roughly a 70% score to proceed. It is meant to confirm you understand basic futures concepts and the program rules before you risk an evaluation. Treat it as a quick rules refresher rather than a hard gate, since you can study the included education material first. Verify the current format on Earn2Trade's Help Center.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_184_q: How many funded Earn2Trade accounts can I hold at once?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_184_a: You can hold up to three funded accounts with Earn2Trade's partner firms at the same time. Each one must be traded independently, because submitting the identical trades across accounts at the same moment looks like copier activity and can cost you those accounts. If you want multiple accounts, run genuinely separate decisions on each rather than mirroring one master. Verify the current cap on Earn2Trade's Help Center.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_185_q: Which FCM actually holds the money and clears trades on a Live account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_185_a: On a Live account your trades clear through a registered Futures Commission Merchant, with Ironbeam being the FCM associated with Earn2Trade's live futures option. That means a regulated firm holds the funds and is accountable for clearing, which is the main practical difference from the simulated LiveSim path. Most traders still choose LiveSim because it avoids the upfront fees and CME professional-data status that come with a real FCM account. Verify the current FCM arrangement on Earn2Trade's official site.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_186_q: What does the Bootcamp actually cost and how long does it run?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_186_a: The Bootcamp is a structured multi-month program (around four months) that bundles video lessons, weekly group webinars, individual mentorship, simulator practice, and an end-of-course Gauntlet attempt, typically as a one-time payment in the ballpark of $2,499. It is aimed at newer traders who want guided coaching plus a path to a funded evaluation in one package. If you already know how to trade and just want funding, a standalone TCP or Gauntlet Mini subscription is far cheaper. Verify current Bootcamp pricing on Earn2Trade's official site.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_187_q: After I pass, how long do I have before I must activate my LiveSim account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_187_a: You generally have 30 days after passing to activate your LiveSim account, and a delayed start within that window is fine. This gives you breathing room to complete KYC, sign the funded-trader agreement, and set up your platform without rushing. If you let the window lapse without activating, you risk losing the offer, so confirm the deadline in your post-pass instructions. Verify the current activation window on Earn2Trade's official site.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_188_q: Can I pay for the evaluation with crypto instead of a card?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_188_a: Yes. Earn2Trade accepts both credit cards and cryptocurrency for purchasing an evaluation plan, so you can fund your subscription with crypto if you prefer. This is separate from how you later receive payouts, which has its own set of methods. If you pay with crypto, keep your transaction records in case support needs to verify a payment. Verify accepted payment methods on Earn2Trade's official site.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_189_q: Will I get a 1099 tax form on a LiveSim account, or only on a Live account?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_189_a: For US traders, the funding partner issues a 1099 (typically a 1099-NEC) once your annual payouts cross the reporting threshold, and this applies to payout income regardless of whether the account was Live or LiveSim, because both pay out real profit splits. The payouts are generally treated as independent-contractor business income rather than capital gains. Keep a record of every withdrawal so your reported total matches the form. This is general information, not tax advice, so confirm your situation with a tax professional and verify details on Earn2Trade's official site.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_190_q: Will I get only one account if Earn2Trade detects I used a copier to pass several at once?
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_faq_190_a: Yes. If Earn2Trade finds you used a trade copier to pass multiple evaluations, they will fund only one account and you will not be refunded on the others, and copiers are also not permitted on funded Live or LiveSim accounts. The cleaner approach is to trade each account on its own decisions, or to use PickMyTrade purely to automate your own TradingView strategy onto a single Earn2Trade account through Rithmic, which keeps your execution legitimate and hands-free. Always keep automation positive and rule-compliant, and verify the current automation policy on Earn2Trade's Help Center.
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_cta_h2: Automate Your Tradovate Workflow with PickMyTrade
prop_firm_faq.earn2trade_cta_text: Earn2Trade's automation rules are strict, but if you trade Tradovate-hosted accounts at firms that allow automation (Apex, MFFU, Tradeify, FundedNext), PickMyTrade is the no-code webhook bridge that turns TradingView alerts into Tradovate orders, processed in under 200ms on our side, encrypted, $50/month flat across all your accounts and brokers.
