prop_firm_faq.webhooks_related_4: TradingView Webhook Fails to Place Trades
prop_firm_faq.hub_card_webhooks_text: Alerts that do not fire, bar-close timing, strategy alert modes, plan and 2FA requirements and webhook delivery, answered from TradingView docs.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_1_q: Why didn't my TradingView alert fire?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_1_a: Run five checks from TradingView's Pine Script FAQ. First, confirm the alert is active and not expired, because created alerts do not fire after they expire. Second, open the alert log: an alert can fire without sending a notification. Third, check for repainting, which shifts when signals appear. Fourth, TradingView halts an alert that triggers more than 15 times in 3 minutes. Fifth, a script runtime error stops that script's alerts. Also, an alert runs on a saved copy of the script and its inputs, so after changing settings on your chart, delete the alert and create a new one.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_2_q: What is the difference between "Once per bar" and "Once per bar close" alerts?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_2_a: "Once per bar" fires the first time the condition is true while the candle is still forming. "Once per bar close" waits for the candle to close and fires only if the condition is still true then. The trade-off: "Once per bar" is earlier but can fire on a signal that disappears by the close, for example an RSI cross that reverses before the bar ends, according to TradingView's Help Center. If you want alerts to match what the chart shows after the close, the Pine Script FAQ recommends "Once Per Bar Close".
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_3_q: Strategy alerts: what is the difference between "order fills" and "alert() function calls"?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_3_a: They are the two trigger types for an alert on a TradingView strategy. "Order fills" fires whenever the strategy's simulated broker fills an order, such as an entry, exit, stop or target. "alert() function calls" fires only when the script runs an alert() call its author wrote. Per the Pine Script docs, strategies run alert() calls only at bar close by default, while alerts from order fill events "execute immediately", which the docs call "often more suitable for sending alerts to third parties for automation." If the script has no alert() calls, that option sends nothing.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_4_q: Do TradingView webhooks need a paid plan and two-factor authentication?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_4_a: Yes to both, as of 5 Oct 2026. TradingView's pricing comparison table marks "Webhook notifications" as not included on the free Basic plan and included on Essential, Plus, Premium and Ultimate. Separately, the Help Center says webhook alerts are only allowed when two-factor authentication is enabled. So you need a paid plan and 2FA turned on in your TradingView account before you can use webhook alerts. TradingView also warns not to put login credentials or passwords in the webhook message body.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_5_q: Why is my TradingView webhook not reaching my URL?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_5_a: Check TradingView's documented webhook limits first. The Help Center says only ports 80 and 443 are accepted, requests are cancelled if the receiving server takes longer than three seconds to process them, and IPv6 is not supported. If your server has a firewall, allowlist the four TradingView IP addresses listed on that Help Center page. Then open the alert log and read the "Webhook status" column, which shows delivery failures. TradingView also notes webhooks may occasionally fail to reach the URL, so treat a webhook as a best-effort channel, not guaranteed delivery.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_6_q: How many indicators can I use on the free TradingView plan?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_6_a: Two per chart. TradingView's pricing page, checked 5 Oct 2026, lists indicators per chart as 2 on Basic (free), 5 on Essential, 10 on Plus, 25 on Premium and 50 on Ultimate. The free plan is also tighter on alerts: the comparison table shows 3 active price alerts on Basic and marks technical alerts as not included. TradingView counts any alert built on an indicator, strategy or drawing as a technical alert, so alerts from an indicator need a paid plan. Plan limits change, so check the pricing page before you buy.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_7_q: Can a TradingView strategy alert fire before the candle closes?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_7_a: Yes, but there is a cost. By default a TradingView strategy calculates only when a bar closes. Turning on "On realtime bar tick" in the strategy's Script execution settings (calc_on_every_tick = true in code) lets it calculate on every price update, so orders and alerts can fire mid-candle. The Pine Script docs warn this can cause repainting in the strategy's orders and results, because after a reload, historical bars do not keep the intrabar ticks the strategy acted on. The backtest may then not show the trades your live alerts sent.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_8_q: Does TradingView have a delay on alerts?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_8_a: TradingView documents specific delay cases, not a general latency figure. Its Help Center says "Once Per Bar Close" alerts wait for the first trade of the next bar to confirm the close, so on thinly traded symbols they can arrive several seconds late; if no trades arrive, for example after a session closes, the server closes the bar 1 minute after its formal close. Strategy alerts can also look late in the Strategy Tester, because historical orders show the bar's open time, not the real fill time. We found no official TradingView figure for total alert-to-broker latency.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_9_q: Is TradingView's futures data delayed on the free plan?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_9_a: Yes for CME Group markets unless you add real-time data. TradingView's CME page states that all CME Group data is free on TradingView with a 10-minute delay, and real-time CME, CBOT, COMEX and NYMEX data is sold as a separate subscription. The Help Center adds a catch for traders who connect a broker: the order panel and buy and sell buttons use your broker's data, not TradingView's, so those quotes can still be delayed even after you buy real-time chart data. Check which feed your chart and order panel use before trading.
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_10_q: Do TradingView alerts still work if I close the chart or turn off my computer?
prop_firm_faq.webhooks_faq_10_a: Yes. TradingView's Help Center says alerts are server-side, so you can close TradingView or leave the chart page and they keep working. When you create an alert on a script, TradingView saves a copy of the script, its inputs, the symbol and the timeframe, and runs that copy on its servers. The catch: later edits on your chart do not reach the running alert. If you change a setting, symbol or timeframe, delete the old alert and create a new one, or it keeps firing on the old settings.

prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_basics_title: What Is TickTickTrader and How Does It Work?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_1_q: What is TickTickTrader and how does it work?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_1_a: TickTickTrader (TTT) is a futures-only prop firm launched in early 2022. You either pass a one-step evaluation (TTTPerformance) or buy a Direct (instant-funded) account (TTTDirect / S2F+). Hit profit targets and follow rules to earn payouts. After 6 successful payouts in the SIM phase, qualified traders transition to a live funded account.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_2_q: Is TickTickTrader legit or a scam in 2026?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_2_a: Legit. TTT carries a ~4.7-4.8/5 Trustpilot rating across 6,000-6,300+ reviews (May 2026), has been operating since February 2022, pays through Rise, and now runs exclusively on Rithmic-based platforms (NinjaTrader, Quantower, Sierra Chart, R|Trader Pro) after losing Tradovate (Nov 2025 migration to ProjectX) and ProjectX (Feb 2026 Topstep exclusivity). Some commentary suggests TTT is in operational difficulty post-platform-loss - verify current status on tickticktrader.com before funding.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_3_q: Who owns TickTickTrader and where is it based?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_3_a: Gerardo Tolivia Mariscal is publicly identified as CEO/Founder of TickTickTrader. The operating entity is UAB TickTickTrader, registered in Lithuania. The TTT group also maintains a corporate presence in Romania (Bucharest) and Douglas, Isle of Man. The firm is privately held.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_4_a: Founded in February 2022 as a futures-focused prop firm with a one-step evaluation and instant-funding model. CEO/Founder is Gerardo Tolivia Mariscal; operating entity is UAB TickTickTrader registered in Lithuania.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_5_a: Most countries except OFAC-sanctioned (Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus). Verify country eligibility on the signup page before paying.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_6_q: Do I need to be a US citizen?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_6_a: No. TTT accepts global traders. Non-US traders submit a W-8BEN (or W-8BEN-E for entities) at first payout.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_7_q: What's the minimum age to join TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_7_a: 18 years old, standard for retail prop firms.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_8_q: What asset class does TickTickTrader cover?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_8_a: CME futures only - equity indices (ES, NQ, RTY, YM and micros), metals (GC, SI), energies (CL, NG), currencies (6E, 6A), agriculturals (ZC, ZS), and crypto micros (MBT, MET). No forex, no equities, no options.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_9_q: Is TickTickTrader a broker or a prop firm?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_9_a: Prop firm. TTT does not hold customer funds. You pay an evaluation/activation fee and trade in a simulated environment until you reach the live phase. Order routing is now handled exclusively via Rithmic (NinjaTrader, Quantower, Sierra Chart, R|Trader Pro) after TTT lost Tradovate (November 2025) and ProjectX (February 2026).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_10_q: What makes TickTickTrader different from Topstep or Apex?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_10_a: Three differentiators: (1) one-step evaluation with no minimum trading days, (2) end-of-day trailing drawdown on Direct accounts (intraday spikes don't shrink your DD), (3) S2F+ instant-funding model on Rithmic that splits payouts into cash + live wallet. Note: TTT lost Tradovate access in November 2025 and ProjectX in February 2026, so it now runs only on Rithmic-based platforms.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_basics_11_a: ~4.7-4.8/5 across 6,000-6,300+ reviews as of May 2026. Most criticism focuses on the March 2025 SIM split reduction, payout caps, and the late-2025/early-2026 platform losses (Tradovate Nov 2025, ProjectX Feb 2026) - not on whether payouts are processed.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_plans_title: What Are the TickTickTrader Performance, Direct, and S2F+ Plans?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_1_q: What's the difference between TTTPerformance and TTTDirect?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_1_a: TTTPerformance = evaluation path (you pass a one-step eval, then graduate to a sim-funded performance account). TTTDirect = instant-funding (you skip the eval, pay a one-time fee, start trading toward payouts immediately). Different consistency rules, different splits, different drawdown logic.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_2_a: S2F+ is TTT's instant-funding model launched July 23, 2025 (originally on Tradovate and ProjectX). After TTT lost Tradovate (Nov 2025) and ProjectX (Feb 2026), S2F+ now runs on Rithmic-based platforms only. No consistency rule. Uses a Profit Score (PS) system: 1 point per day with PnL ≥ 0.5% of account size, payout at PS≥10 first, then PS≥7 thereafter. Payout split: 50% cash + 40% live wallet + 10% commission.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_3_q: Which plan is best for a brand-new prop trader?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_3_a: TTTPerformance Express ($100K, ~$99 for 15 days) is the cheapest, fastest test of your strategy. If you fail, you've spent $99 and learned. The standard $25K Starter ($87–$145/month) is the lowest-stakes option.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_4_q: Which plan is best for a profitable trader who hates evals?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_4_a: TTTDirect $50K Base or $100K Core. Skip the evaluation, start trading toward payouts immediately. Pay once, no re-billing. The 80/20 SIM split is the trade-off.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_5_q: Which plan is best for someone wanting fast cash payouts?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_plans_5_a: S2F+ on Rithmic (NinjaTrader / Quantower / Sierra Chart / R|Trader Pro). The 50% cash + 40% wallet split means half your earnings are real cash immediately. Plus there's no consistency rule, just the Profit Score system.

prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sizes_10_a: $999 list, ~$549 discounted. The largest plan; 27 mini contracts max.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_targets_title: What Are TickTickTrader's Profit Targets and Pass Rules?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_1_a: Yes. TTT periodically offers Bundle plans that include 3 accounts at the same time. Activation fee around $149 per validated account at the funded stage.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_2_q: Is the Direct account a one-time fee or recurring?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_2_a: One-time fee. There is no monthly subscription on TTTDirect - you pay once and trade until you breach a rule.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_3_q: Is the Evaluation account a one-time fee or recurring?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_3_a: Recurring. Evaluations bill monthly (Express bills every 15 days). Cancel anytime in your dashboard before the next billing date.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_4_q: What's the profit target on the $25K eval?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_4_a: $1,500 (6% of starting balance). One step, no minimum trading days.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_5_q: What's the profit target on the $50K eval?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_5_a: $3,000 (6%). Same one-step, no minimum trading days.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_6_q: What's the profit target on the $100K Express?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_6_a: $6,000 (6%). 15-day window. No daily loss limit, but a tighter trailing drawdown ($3,500).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_7_q: What's the profit target on the $100K Professional eval?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_7_a: $6,000 (6%) with the standard daily loss limit ($2,500) and a $3,500 trailing drawdown.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_8_q: What's the profit buffer on the $50K Base Direct?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_8_a: $1,000 minimum balance buffer above starting capital before your first payout (i.e., balance must reach $51,000).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_9_q: What's the profit buffer on the $100K Core Direct?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_9_a: $2,000 buffer above starting capital ($102,000 balance) for first payout.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_10_q: What's the profit buffer on the $150K Prime Direct?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_targets_10_a: $3,000 buffer ($153,000 balance) for first payout. $5,000 buffer ($255,000 balance) for $250K Zenith.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_drawdown_title: How Do TickTickTrader's Drawdown Rules Work?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_1_q: Is there a 2% profit target between payouts on Direct?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_1_a: Yes. Effective January 21, 2025, each subsequent payout requires hitting a 2% profit target on the account size since the last payout.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_2_q: Is there a minimum number of trading days?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_2_a: No. TTT is a one-step evaluation with no minimum trading days. If you hit the profit target on day 1 without breaching DD or DLL, you pass.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_3_q: Is there a maximum time to pass the eval?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_3_a: No hard time limit on standard evals - keep paying the monthly subscription. Express is the exception: 15 days to hit the target.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_4_q: What kind of drawdown does TTT use?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_4_a: Two types depending on plan. Evaluation accounts use a tick-based trailing drawdown that locks (becomes static) once you reach breakeven plus the buffer. TTTDirect uses an end-of-day trailing drawdown - only realized closing balances move it.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_5_q: How does the end-of-day trailing drawdown work?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_5_a: It only adjusts at the end of the trading day, based on your closing balance. Unrealized intraday gains do NOT lift your DD threshold. Example: open balance $100,500, close at $100,000 - your trailing DD stays at $96,500. This protects against giving back intraday spikes.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_6_q: How does tick-based trailing drawdown work on the eval?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_6_a: It moves with your equity in real time (every tick). Once your account hits the locking point (initial balance + DD buffer), the DD freezes at that breakeven line.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_7_q: What's the max drawdown on the $25K Starter?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_8_q: What's the max drawdown on the $50K Advanced?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_9_q: What's the max drawdown on the $100K Express?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_9_a: $3,500 trailing. No daily loss limit on Express, but the tighter DD is the trade-off.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_10_q: What's the max drawdown on the $100K Professional eval?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_10_a: $3,500 trailing with a $2,500 daily loss limit.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_11_q: What's the EOD drawdown on the four Direct sizes?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_11_a: $50K Base: $2,000 EOD trailing. $100K Core: $5,000 EOD trailing (officially raised in 2025). $150K Prime: $6,000. $250K Zenith: $9,000. Always verify the current figures in your dashboard before trading.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_12_q: Does the trailing drawdown lock after passing?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_drawdown_12_a: On Evaluation: yes - once you hit breakeven plus the DD buffer, it locks. On TTTDirect: it remains end-of-day trailing throughout the SIM phase. Live accounts use static drawdown.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_dll_title: What Are TickTickTrader's Daily Loss Limits?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_1_q: Are unrealized profits used to push the DD up?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_1_a: On TTTDirect: no - only realized closing balances. On Eval (tick-based): yes, peaks track real-time equity until breakeven lock.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_2_q: What happens if I breach the drawdown?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_2_a: Account is failed/closed. You can pay a reset fee on Evaluation accounts ($85) to restart, or buy a new Direct account.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_3_q: What's the daily loss limit on $25K Starter?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_4_q: What's the daily loss limit on $50K Advanced?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_5_q: Does the $100K Express really have no daily loss limit?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_5_a: Yes - the Express plan has no DLL, which is its main appeal. The trade-off is a tighter trailing drawdown ($3,500) and a 15-day deadline.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_6_q: What's the daily loss limit on $100K Professional?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_7_q: What are the daily loss limits across the four Direct sizes?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_7_a: $50K Base: $1,250 soft. $100K Core: $2,500 soft. $150K Prime: $3,750 soft. $250K Zenith: $6,250 soft. All are SOFT limits - hitting them pauses the account for the day rather than terminating it.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_8_q: What's the difference between a soft and hard DLL?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_8_a: Hard DLL (Eval) = breach kills the account. Soft DLL (Direct) = breach pauses trading until next session, account survives. The soft limit is one of TTTDirect's signature features.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_9_q: Does the daily loss reset at midnight?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_dll_9_a: It resets at the daily session boundary (5:00 PM ET / CME daily reset). New trading day, fresh DLL counter.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_consistency_title: What Are TickTickTrader's 30% and 20% Consistency Rules?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_1_q: What is the consistency rule on TTTPerformance accounts?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_1_a: 30% rule. Your largest single profit day cannot exceed 30% of total accumulated profits when you request a payout. Designed to prevent one-shot lottery wins.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_2_q: What is the consistency rule on TTTDirect accounts?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_2_a: 20% rule. Stricter than Performance. Your biggest day cannot exceed 20% of total profits at payout request.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_3_q: Does S2F+ have a consistency rule?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_3_a: No - S2F+ explicitly removes the consistency rule. It uses the Profit Score system instead, which rewards consistent positive days without capping the size of any single day.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_4_q: How is the consistency rule calculated?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_4_a: (Largest profit day ÷ Total profits) × 100. If on TTTDirect that ratio exceeds 20%, you must trade more days until you rebalance below the threshold before requesting payout.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_5_q: Can I fix a consistency breach?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_5_a: Yes - accumulate more smaller-day profits to dilute the ratio. The rule only blocks payouts; it doesn't kill the account.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_6_q: Do losing days count toward consistency?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_consistency_6_a: Only your profit days are summed for the denominator (total profits). Loss days reduce the running total but aren't averaged in separately.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_payouts_title: How Do TickTickTrader Payouts and Profit Splits Work?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_2_q: Is the first payout capped on TTTDirect?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_2_a: Yes. Initial payout caps are tiered and size-dependent - not a universal $2K/$5K/$10K progression across all account sizes. Larger Direct accounts have higher caps. Verify the current per-size cap schedule on support.tickticktrader.com before requesting payout.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_3_a: On TTTPerformance: anytime balance and consistency conditions are met. On TTTDirect: requires a 10-day trading period between payouts plus the 2% profit target.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_4_q: How long do payouts take to process?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_4_a: Officially up to 5 business days. In practice many traders report 24 hours; S2F+ averages 24h per TTT's published leaderboards.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_5_a: Rise (rise.works) - a global payouts platform that supports bank wires, ACH, USDT, and local bank rails in 100+ countries.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_6_a: Bank wire, Rise local rails, and crypto (USDT TRC20 - typically capped under $1,000 per request). Method availability depends on your country.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_7_q: What is the profit split during the SIM phase on TTTDirect?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_7_a: 80/20 (you keep 80%) - effective March 24, 2025. Down from the previous 90/10. Applies to payouts requested on/after that date.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_8_q: What is the profit split on TTTPerformance?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_8_a: 100% to trader for the first 3 months after passing, then 90/10 (trader keeps 90%) thereafter.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_9_q: What is the profit split on the live (post-6th-payout) account?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_9_a: 90/10 (you keep 90%) on the live phase, regardless of starting account type.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_10_q: How does the S2F+ payout split work?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_10_a: Per payout: 50% paid as cash to you, 40% added to your Live Wallet (real trading capital), 10% retained by TTT as commission. The Live Wallet grows your real-money trading power as you keep earning.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_11_a: S2F+ specific. The 40% portion of each payout is credited to a Live Wallet that funds your real-capital trading once you transition. Effectively a built-in scaling mechanism.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_12_q: How many payouts before I get to live capital?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_12_a: 6 successful payouts in the SIM phase. The Risk Management team can fast-track at their discretion based on quality of trading.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_13_q: What is the minimum balance required for first payout per Direct size?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_13_a: $50K Base needs $51,000. $100K Core needs $102,000. $150K Prime needs $153,000. $250K Zenith needs $255,000. Plus consistency rule must be satisfied.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_14_a: Yes. US traders earning $600+ in a year typically receive a 1099-NEC. Non-US traders submit a W-8BEN/W-8BEN-E to claim treaty rates. Always consult a tax professional.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_15_q: Will I receive a US 1099 from TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_payouts_15_a: Yes, US-based traders earning $600+ in a calendar year are issued a 1099 via Rise. International traders receive payment summaries instead.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_scaling_title: How Does TickTickTrader Handle Scaling, Contracts, and Multiple Accounts?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_1_q: Is there scaling? How many contracts can I trade?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_1_a: As of January 2024, there is NO scaling plan. You can trade your full contract allotment from day 1, both during the eval and after funded. Limits: 4 minis on $25K, 10 on $50K, 14 on $100K, 17 on $150K, 27 on $250K.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_2_q: How many micros can I trade?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_2_a: 10× the mini limit. So 40 micros on $25K, 100 on $50K, 140 on $100K, 170 on $150K, 270 on $250K. You can mix mini and micro contracts as long as the equivalent total stays under the cap (10 micros = 1 mini).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_3_a: $5 per round-turn standard contract. Micro contracts run lower (per-tick basis). Commission is automatic and charged to your account each fill.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_4_a: Yes. Commissions and fees are realized losses; they affect both your end-of-day balance and your trailing drawdown.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_5_q: Can I open multiple TTT accounts?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_5_a: Yes - up to 13 total per trader: a maximum of 10 S2F+ accounts plus up to 3 other Direct/Eval combined. The earlier 5-per-trader Direct cap has been replaced by this newer structure. Verify current limits on the official TTT support pages before purchasing.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_6_q: Can I trade the same strategy across multiple TTT accounts?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_scaling_6_a: Yes - copy trading between YOUR own accounts is allowed. Cross-trader copy trading (mirroring someone else's account) is prohibited.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_rules_title: What Are TickTickTrader's Rules on News Trading, Hedging, and Copy Trading?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_1_q: Is news trading allowed on TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_1_a: Yes. News trading is explicitly allowed during major events like NFP, CPI, and FOMC. Just be aware of slippage and DLL risk during high-volatility moments.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_2_q: Does TTT freeze trading around news events?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_2_a: No - unlike many forex prop firms, TTT does not impose a 5-minute pre/post news freeze on most plans. Confirm via the help center for your specific plan.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_3_a: No. Hedging across or within accounts is banned - both same-symbol opposing positions and inter-account correlated hedges.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_4_a: Holding offsetting long+short positions on the same instrument or correlated instruments (ES vs NQ, MES vs ES, etc.) at the same time. Net-flat strategies that bypass DLL are the target of this rule.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_5_a: Standard scalping is allowed. Micro-scalping (sub-5-second holds) is widely reported to be still banned - earlier 'lifted March 23, 2025' claims are unverified. Always verify the current scalping policy on the TTT support pages before deploying short-hold strategies.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_6_q: Is HFT or sub-second algorithmic trading allowed?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_6_a: No. TTT specifically bans HFT and sub-second algorithmic trading. However, TTT does allow automated trading via approved Rithmic-compatible webhook bridges such as PickMyTrade. The ban targets HFT/sub-second bots and third-party cross-trader copy services - not all automation.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_7_q: Are EAs and trading bots allowed?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_7_a: Automation is allowed via approved Rithmic-compatible webhook bridges - PickMyTrade is one such option, and webhook-driven order routing (TradingView → Rithmic via a bridge) is permitted in most cases. The hard bans target HFT/sub-second algos and third-party cross-trader copy services. Manual click-to-execute is always fine. Verify your specific bridge with TTT support.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_8_q: Can I run the same strategy across multiple TTT accounts?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_8_a: Running the same strategy across multiple TTT accounts simultaneously is allowed. With PickMyTrade, connect each Rithmic account separately and a single TradingView alert executes on all of them at once — this is automation via a single alert, not the Manual Trade Copier. PickMyTrade supports automating multiple TickTick Trader (Rithmic) accounts simultaneously using a single TradingView alert — connect each account separately in PickMyTrade and the same alert fires to all of them at once. Note: the Manual Trade Copier feature is not available for Rithmic connections. Copying another trader's account or using a third-party service that mirrors someone else's signals is strictly prohibited and grounds for termination.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_9_a: No. VPN/proxy use is prohibited. TTT enforces real-IP access; using a VPN can flag and disable the account.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_10_a: Yes. Standard DCA and position flipping are permitted. Just stay within your contract limit at any one moment.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_11_a: Yes. Closing a long and immediately opening a short (or vice versa) is allowed. No same-instrument hedge moment is created if you actually closed first.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_12_q: Are martingale or grid strategies allowed?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_rules_12_a: Allowed in principle, but most blow up the DLL or DD before reaching payout. Stay under contract caps and DLL/DD thresholds.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_hours_title: What Are TickTickTrader's Trading Hours, Inactivity, Reset, and Refund Policies?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_1_q: What are the trading hours on TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_1_a: CME Globex hours: Sunday 6:00 PM ET through Friday 5:00 PM ET, with the standard 60-minute daily maintenance break (4:00 PM – 5:00 PM ET on most index futures).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_2_q: Do I have to flatten by 5 PM ET each day?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_2_a: Open futures positions are auto-closed by CME's daily settlement (this is a CME mechanic, not a TTT-specific forced liquidation). TTTDirect allows a one-time overnight reactivation if you opt to hold across the daily reset window. Holding positions through settlement without reactivation can flag your account.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_3_q: Can I hold positions overnight or over the weekend?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_3_a: TTT Direct accounts allow overnight holds with a one-time reactivation per session. Futures are auto-closed at CME daily settlement (not a TTT-specific forced liquidation). Weekend holds are not permitted. Performance evaluation accounts are day-trading only.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_4_q: What happens if my account is inactive?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_4_a: 7+ consecutive days of inactivity flags the account; extended inactivity terminates it. Place at least one trade per week to keep the account live.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_5_q: Can I reset a failed evaluation account?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_5_a: Yes. Pay an $85 reset fee to restart the same evaluation subscription. Discount codes (HTG50R 50% off, RESET25 for $25, GXDLLUHX 60% off) are commonly available.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_6_q: Can I reset a failed Direct account?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_6_a: No. Direct accounts are one-time fee - failure means buying a new account at the activation price (often discounted).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_7_a: No. All subscriptions and account fees are FINAL. No refunds, returns, or exchanges once payment is processed. Failure to use the purchased service does not entitle you to a refund.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_8_q: What happens if I file a chargeback?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_hours_8_a: Any chargeback triggers an investigation. You will be permanently banned from purchasing TTT services going forward, and any future attempts will be auto-refunded and blocked.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_1_q: How do I cancel my evaluation subscription?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_1_a: Log into your TTT dashboard, go to Active Subscriptions, click cancel on the relevant account. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle - no further charges.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_2_q: Will my account stay active until end of cycle if I cancel?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_2_a: Yes. You can keep trading until the period you've already paid for ends. Account is deactivated at cycle end, not immediately on cancellation.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_3_a: Rithmic-based platforms only (May 2026): NinjaTrader, Quantower, Sierra Chart, R|Trader Pro, MultiCharts, Jigsaw DayTradr, Bookmap, Photon Trader, and CQG. TTT lost Tradovate access in November 2025 (Tradovate accounts were migrated to ProjectX), then lost ProjectX in February 2026 when ProjectX went exclusive to Topstep. The current TTT stack is Rithmic-routed end-to-end.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_4_q: Is Tradovate the primary platform on TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_4_a: No. As of May 2026, Tradovate is NOT supported on TTT. Tradovate dropped TTT in November 2025 and all Tradovate accounts were migrated to ProjectX. Then in February 2026, ProjectX went exclusive to Topstep, so TTT lost ProjectX too. TTT's current primary stack is Rithmic - front-end via NinjaTrader, Quantower, Sierra Chart, or R|Trader Pro.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_5_a: No longer supported. TTT lost ProjectX access in February 2026 when ProjectX went exclusive to Topstep. Earlier (November 2025), TTT had used ProjectX as a fallback after Tradovate dropped them - but that arrangement ended. As of May 2026, TTT runs exclusively on Rithmic-based platforms.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_6_a: Yes - Rithmic is now TTT's primary and exclusive backend (May 2026). Any Rithmic-compatible front-end (NinjaTrader, Quantower, Sierra Chart, R|Trader Pro, MultiCharts, Jigsaw DayTradr, Bookmap) works with TTT Rithmic-routed accounts. This is the only platform path after TTT lost Tradovate (Nov 2025) and ProjectX (Feb 2026).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_7_q: Are NinjaTrader / Bookmap / DayTradr included free?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_7_a: TTT periodically bundles free licenses for NinjaTrader, Bookmap, and Jigsaw DayTradr with eligible plans. Check the active promo on the order page when you buy.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_8_q: Is there a TTT mobile app?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_8_a: TTT itself doesn't ship a mobile app. Since TTT now runs exclusively on Rithmic, use Rithmic-compatible mobile front-ends - R|Trader Pro mobile clients or third-party Rithmic mobile apps.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_9_q: Does TTT charge market data fees?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_9_a: Since TTT runs exclusively on Rithmic now, Rithmic CME data fees apply (~$85/month for non-professional users). TTT typically bundles data into the account activation flow - verify which fees are included on the current order page before purchasing.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_10_q: Do I need to sign a CME data agreement?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_10_a: Yes - CME data agreement at first login. Choose Non-Professional unless you genuinely qualify as Professional (registered, organization data subscription, etc.). Most retail traders are Non-Pro.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_11_q: Can I use Quantower with TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_11_a: Yes via Rithmic backend. Connect Quantower to Rithmic with your TTT-issued Rithmic credentials.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_12_q: Can I use a personal NinjaTrader license on TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_platforms_12_a: Yes. Connect NinjaTrader to your TTT-issued Rithmic credentials (CQG also supported on some plans). NinjaTrader's free Lifetime License works for sim/eval accounts; live brokerage requires their paid license.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_automation_title: Does TickTickTrader Allow Automation via TradingView and PickMyTrade?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_1_q: How do I connect TradingView to my TTT (Rithmic) account?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_1_a: TTT no longer supports Tradovate (post Nov 2025), so the native Tradovate-TradingView broker-panel path is gone. The current path is TradingView → Rithmic bridge or a third-party webhook service (e.g., PickMyTrade). You receive TradingView alerts, the bridge converts them into Rithmic orders against your TTT account.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_2_q: Does TradingView have native auto-trading for TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_2_a: No. Since TTT lost Tradovate in November 2025, there is no native TradingView broker integration for TTT accounts. Auto-execution requires a Rithmic-compatible webhook bridge such as PickMyTrade. TTT generally allows automation; HFT/sub-second algos and cross-trader copy services remain banned.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_3_q: Can I use TradingView alerts to trade TTT manually?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_3_a: Yes - receiving an alert and clicking the order yourself in your Rithmic front-end (NinjaTrader / Quantower / Sierra Chart / R|Trader Pro) is fully manual trading. TTT has no rule against using TradingView as a charting / signal tool.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_4_q: Can I automate TradingView alerts to a TTT (Rithmic) account via PickMyTrade?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_4_a: Yes. PickMyTrade routes TradingView alerts to your TTT Rithmic account via a webhook bridge. TTT generally allows automation via webhook bridges (the firm-wide bans target HFT/sub-second algos and cross-trader copy services, not all automation). Best practice: confirm your specific automation pattern with TTT support before deploying.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_5_q: Is webhook automation explicitly approved by TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_5_a: Webhook-based automation is generally permitted on TTT accounts. PickMyTrade works with TTT via Rithmic to route TradingView alerts to your TTT account. The explicit bans are on HFT/sub-second algorithmic trading and third-party cross-trader copy services. Always check TickTick Trader's official website for the latest compliance guidelines. Many PickMyTrade customers successfully automate their TTT accounts — a small amount of risk is always involved with automated trading on any prop firm.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_6_q: What does PickMyTrade cost for TTT users?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_6_a: $50/month per broker connection. Covers unlimited strategies, unlimited TTT accounts, and unlimited trades. No per-trade fees.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_7_q: How fast is PickMyTrade execution to TTT (Rithmic)?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_7_a: PMT processes your order in under 200ms on our side (TradingView alert → PMT processing → Rithmic fill); total end-to-end time also depends on your network and Rithmic. Fast enough for swing and intraday strategies; not appropriate for sub-second HFT (which TTT bans anyway).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_8_q: How do I set up PMT with my TTT (Rithmic) credentials?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_8_a: Go to pickmytrade.io, add Rithmic as your broker connection, and paste your TTT-issued Rithmic username, password, and Rithmic system. Then use Generate Alert to get your JSON configuration and webhook URL. Paste the webhook URL into your TradingView alert and the JSON into the alert message. Full setup guide: https://docs.pickmytrade.io/docs/pickmytrade-rithmic-setup/
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_9_q: Will running PMT during the eval get me banned?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_automation_9_a: TTT allows automation via approved bridges, and the same policy applies in eval and live phases. The bans target HFT/sub-second algos and cross-trader copy services. Webhook-driven trading through PMT (Rithmic-routed) is generally permitted, but you should confirm your specific setup with TTT support before deploying.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_sim_live_title: What's the Difference Between TickTickTrader's SIM and Live Phases?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_1_q: Can I broadcast one TradingView alert to multiple TTT accounts via PMT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_1_a: You can automate multiple TickTick Trader accounts simultaneously using a single TradingView alert — connect each Rithmic account separately in PickMyTrade and the same alert fires to all of them.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_2_q: What's the difference between SIM phase and Live phase on TTT?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_2_a: SIM phase = your trading is in a simulated environment but payouts are real cash. Live phase = real exchange execution, real CME fills. Transition happens after 6 successful SIM payouts.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_3_q: Are TTT SIM payouts real money?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_3_a: Yes - the cash payout is real money sent to you via Rise. The TRADING is simulated until you reach the live phase. This is the standard prop firm SIM model.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_4_q: How long does it take to reach the live phase?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_4_a: Six successful payouts. With TTTDirect's 10-day cooldown between payouts and 2% profit target, that's a minimum of ~60 trading days assuming you hit every cycle. Most traders take longer.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_5_q: Does the live phase have different drawdown rules?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_sim_live_5_a: Yes. Live accounts use a STATIC drawdown (no longer trailing). The DLL also typically lifts. Exact terms are presented at the live transition agreement.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_compare_title: How Does TickTickTrader Compare to Other Prop Firms?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_compare_1_q: TickTickTrader vs Topstep - which is better in 2026?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_compare_1_a: Topstep: oldest brand, monthly subscription, TopstepX/ProjectX exclusive (ProjectX went Topstep-exclusive Feb 2026), 14-year track record. TTT: one-step eval, no minimum trading days, end-of-day trailing on Direct, S2F+ instant funding with cash+wallet split, runs on Rithmic-based platforms only (post Tradovate Nov 2025 and ProjectX Feb 2026 platform losses). TTT is more flexible on rules; Topstep is more established and now controls ProjectX.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_compare_2_a: Apex: up to 20 simultaneous accounts, 100% on first $25K per account, intraday trailing DD, $85/month subscription (4.0 model removes monthly), strict 50% consistency. TTT: up to 13 accounts (10 S2F+ + 3 Direct/Eval), end-of-day trailing on Direct (no intraday spike risk), softer DLL, 30%/20% consistency. TTT is gentler on intraday spikes; Apex scales wider.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_compare_3_a: MFFU: 4.9 Trustpilot, no DLL on some plans, next-business-day payouts, monthly subscription on Core/Rapid/Pro. prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_compare_4_a: TPT: monthly subscription, hard EOD trailing DD, simpler rules, decent Trustpilot. TTT: instant-funded option, soft DLL, end-of-day trailing on Direct, S2F+ live wallet model. TPT is simpler; TTT has more product variety.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_compare_5_a: Tradeify (3.0, March 2026): one-time fees only, automation explicitly allowed, Elite Live transition at $80K cumulative, TradeSea AI platform. prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_changes_title: What Has Changed at TickTickTrader Between 2024 and 2026?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_1_q: What changed at TickTickTrader in March 2025?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_1_a: On March 24, 2025: SIM phase split on TTTDirect dropped from 90/10 to 80/20. The previous 90/10 split was grandfathered for accounts with payouts requested before that date.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_2_a: Effective January 21, 2025: TTTDirect requires a 2% profit target between payouts (starting with the second payout). Designed to ensure consistent profitability between cash-outs.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_3_a: Earlier sources claimed micro-scalping (sub-5-second holds) was lifted on March 23, 2025 - this is unverified. As of May 2026, sub-5-second holds appear to still be restricted. Always verify the current scalping policy on TTT support before deploying short-hold strategies.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_4_a: S2F+ on Tradovate. The instant-funding model expanded from ProjectX-only to also include Tradovate. Launch promo dropped 50K S2F+ from $449 to $99 for first-time users (code WELCOME). NOTE: As of May 2026, S2F+ now runs only on Rithmic - Tradovate was lost in Nov 2025 and ProjectX in Feb 2026.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_5_q: What's the Profit Score (PS) system in S2F+?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_5_a: You earn 1 PS point each day your PnL exceeds 0.5% of account size. First payout requires PS≥10; subsequent payouts PS≥7. Replaces the consistency rule and provides a cleaner gamified path to payout eligibility.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_6_q: Is the maximum number of Direct accounts still 5?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_6_a: No. Current cap is up to 13 total per trader: a maximum of 10 S2F+ accounts plus up to 3 other Direct/Eval combined. The earlier 5-Direct limit has been replaced by this newer structure. Verify on official TTT support.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_7_q: Was the 40-trading-day minimum payout requirement removed?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_changes_7_a: Yes. The 40-trading-day minimum for the 100% profit split on Performance accounts was waived in 2024, replaced by the 'first 3 months 100% then 90/10' structure.

prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_2_q: How do I contact TickTickTrader support?

prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_4_q: Is TickTickTrader available in trader forums?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_4_a: Discussion appears in prop firm forums, trader forums, day trader forums. No official forum. prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_5_q: Is the TTT brand spelled 'TickTickTrader' or 'TickTick Trader'?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_5_a: Both spellings appear in the wild. The official brand is 'TickTickTrader' (one word) per their domain ticktick-trader.com and tickticktrader.com. Reviewers and affiliates often use 'TickTick Trader' (two words).
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_6_q: Where can I find current discount codes?

prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_8_q: Final word - is TickTickTrader worth it in 2026?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_support_8_a: Mixed picture as of May 2026. prop_firm_faq.ticktick_cat_gap_title: What's New for TickTickTrader Platform Changes, Payouts, and Automation?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_1_q: How do I get started and activate a TickTickTrader account from scratch?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_1_a: You register on the TickTickTrader dashboard with your name, email, full address, and a username/password, then click Purchase and pick your account type and data-feed provider. For funded/Direct accounts you then complete KYC and sign the trader contract, and pay any activation fee. Note that the activation fee must be paid within a set window (historically 30 days) or the account can be forfeited, so don't sit on it. Confirm the current activation steps and deadline on TickTickTrader's official site, since these have been updated over time.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_2_q: What payment methods can I use to buy a TickTickTrader account?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_2_a: You can purchase a TickTickTrader evaluation or Direct account with any major credit or debit card, and TTT has also supported cryptocurrency and Skrill at checkout. The purchase payment method is separate from how you later receive payouts (that side runs through Riseworks). Available options can change, so check the current checkout screen on TickTickTrader's official site.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_3_q: Why did my Tradovate-based TTT account get moved, and did I have to do anything?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_3_a: TickTickTrader moved accounts off Tradovate because Tradovate stopped supporting external prop providers the way TTT needed, so existing accounts were migrated to a new data feed (ProjectX, with the broader move toward Rithmic-based connectivity). The migration was done on TTT's side ahead of time so your balance, drawdown, and progress carried over; the main action for most traders was logging in fresh and reconnecting their charting platform to the new feed. Because the exact provider and login steps shifted during this transition, verify your current connection method on TickTickTrader's official site before you trade.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_4_q: Which data-feed providers does TickTickTrader partner with now?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_4_a: After leaving Tradovate, TickTickTrader connected accounts through ProjectX and has moved toward Rithmic-based connectivity for charting and order routing. You pick your provider during purchase, then connect a compatible platform (such as a Rithmic-supported app) using the credentials TTT issues. Provider availability has changed more than once during 2025–2026, so confirm which feed your account uses on TickTickTrader's official site.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_5_q: How long do TickTickTrader payouts actually take to hit my account?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_5_a: Once a payout is approved, Riseworks typically processes it within about one to five business days, depending on the method you choose. Bank wire and ACH can sit on the slower end, while crypto (USDT) usually clears faster. Your first payout also can't be requested until you've met the balance, consistency, and any minimum-day conditions, so factor that into your timing.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_6_q: What payout methods does Riseworks offer for TTT, and are there fees?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_6_a: Riseworks pays TickTickTrader traders by bank wire, ACH, or cryptocurrency (USDT). Crypto withdrawals have carried a small per-withdrawal network/gas fee on Layer 1 (around a couple of dollars plus gas), while Layer 2 crypto payouts have been free. Bank rails may have their own intermediary fees depending on your country, so check the current fee schedule inside your Riseworks payout portal.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_7_q: Why would a TickTickTrader payout get denied or delayed?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_7_a: The most common reasons are KYC problems with Riseworks: your country isn't supported by Rise, the details you entered don't match your ID, your documents are expired, or a VPN/proxy trips their checks. Payouts can also be held back if your account balance is below the required safety threshold, if a consistency rule isn't met, or if there's a trading-rule or terms-of-service issue under review. Complete KYC accurately and early, and avoid VPNs during verification, to reduce the chance of a hold. Always confirm current payout requirements on TickTickTrader's official site.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_8_q: What is the Riseworks KYC process and when do I need to complete it?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_8_a: Riseworks is TickTickTrader's payout partner, and completing its KYC (identity verification) is mandatory before you can receive any money. You'll typically verify your identity with a government ID and matching personal details, and you must do this in a region Rise supports. It's smart to finish KYC before your first payout request rather than scrambling at withdrawal time, since onboarding reviews can add days. Verify the latest KYC requirements and supported regions on TickTickTrader's official site.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_9_q: What is the "safety threshold" balance I need before I can withdraw on a Direct account?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_9_a: Each Direct account size has a safety threshold (a minimum balance above your starting balance) that you must stay above to be payout-eligible, and you generally need at least about $250 in profit beyond that threshold to request a withdrawal. As a rough guide traders have cited buffers in the low thousands per size (for example, around $3,600 of cushion on a 100K), but the exact numbers are set per plan. Check your specific account's threshold on TickTickTrader's official site before requesting a payout.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_10_q: How does the S2F+ Profit Score actually work for getting paid?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_10_a: On S2F+ you earn +1 Profit Score each day your P&L clears about 0.5% of the account size, and losing days don't subtract points but simply don't add one. You generally need a Profit Score of around +10 for your first payout and a lower threshold (about +7) for later payout cycles, with a minimum number of qualifying trading days. This rewards steady green days over one big spike, which fits the no-evaluation, instant-funding design of S2F+. Confirm the current Profit Score thresholds on TickTickTrader's official site.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_11_q: Can you show a worked example of the 30% consistency rule?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_11_a: On a Performance account no single day's profit may exceed 30% of your total accumulated profit. So if your best day made $3,000, you need at least $10,000 in total profit for that day to sit at exactly 30% ($3,000 / $10,000 = 30%). Hitting the rule doesn't fail you; it just means you keep trading to grow your total until that big day falls under the cap. Direct accounts use a stricter 20% version, so the same $3,000 day would need $15,000 in total profit.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_12_q: How many contracts can I trade at each TTT account size?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_12_a: Contract limits scale with account size, roughly: 25K around 4 minis (40 micros), 50K around 10 minis (100 micros), and 100K around 14 minis (140 micros), with larger Direct sizes allowing more. Ten micros count as one mini for limit purposes. TTT historically removed the once-funded scaling restriction so you can use your full allotment in both eval and funded phases, but always confirm the current per-size limits on TickTickTrader's official site since they've been revised.
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_13_q: How do I automate a TickTickTrader account through PickMyTrade after the platform change?
prop_firm_faq.ticktick_faq_gap_13_a: PickMyTrade connects to your TickTickTrader account through its current data feed, so you generate or enter your TTT connection credentials in PickMyTrade, link the account, and point your TradingView alert (webhook) at it. From there PickMyTrade translates each alert into a live order on your funded account, including entries, exits, and risk parameters you configure. Because TTT changed its underlying feed, make sure you connect PickMyTrade to the provider your account is actually on now, and keep your automated risk inside TTT's daily-loss and drawdown rules.

prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_12_question: Is it hedging at MyFundedFutures if I go long NQ and short MNQ, or long MES and short MNQ?
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_12_answer: Long NQ against short MNQ is hedging; MES against MNQ is not clearly covered. MFFU prohibits hedging of any kind, defined as buy and sell positions on the same underlying asset at the same time, with E-Mini and Micro NQ given as the example. Its hedging page also says hedging through different unrelated assets is permitted, though relying mainly on hedges makes your trading hard to evaluate. MFFU does not say whether correlated index pairs such as MES and MNQ count as unrelated, so ask support in writing before running that spread.
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_13_question: Can I trade CPI, FOMC or NFP at MyFundedFutures?
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_13_answer: It depends on the account. MFFU lists FOMC meetings and minutes, the Employment Report and CPI as Tier 1 news for all traders. On Rapid Sim Funded and Pro Sim Funded accounts, trading Tier 1 news is prohibited: you must be flat with no orders from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after, for example closed by 8:28:00 for an 8:30 release. All evaluations and Builder plans may trade Tier 1 news. On every account, straddles, strangles and other strategies that exploit the immediate news burst are banned.
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_14_question: When can I take a payout on a MyFundedFutures Rapid account, and what is the buffer?
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_14_answer: On MFFU Rapid plans, Intraday or EOD, payouts are daily once you clear a buffer: $2,100 on 50K, $3,100 on 100K and $4,600 on 150K. The first payout is eligible 24 hours after your first trade if the buffer is met, the minimum withdrawal is $500, there is no consistency rule, and the split is 90/10. On Rapid EOD 50K, each later payout unlocks once net profit since your last payout reaches $500. Builder plans work differently, with a 50% consistency rule and caps of $1,000 or $2,000 per request, and Pro plans pay every 14 calendar days.
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_15_question: Is the MyFundedFutures drawdown trailing intraday or end-of-day, and is there a daily loss limit?
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_15_answer: It depends on the plan. Rapid EOD accounts trail only on end-of-day closes: MFFU says the max loss does not move intraday and never moves down. Standard Rapid sim funded accounts trail intraday from your equity high, including unrealized profit. In both cases open losses count, and the trailing stops once the max loss reaches $100 above zero. Rapid and Rapid EOD have no daily loss limit. MFFU's payout overview says no plan has one, but its Builder 50K guide lists a $1,000 soft pause daily loss limit, so check your plan page.
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_16_question: Can I mix minis and micros to go over my contract limit at MyFundedFutures?
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_16_answer: No. MFFU's Cross Instrument Policy says orders combining different instruments, such as 2 minis and 20 micros, may technically execute even when they exceed your limit, but this is not permitted, and deliberate attempts to get around position scaling are treated as a breach. MFFU's own example: a Rapid 50K sim funded account starting at 2 contracts means 2 minis or 20 micros. Three minis on one instrument is rejected; 2 minis plus 20 micros executes but can breach the account. Limits differ by plan, for example 3 minis or 30 micros on Rapid EOD 50K.
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_17_question: When does MyFundedFutures move me to a Live account, and can I say no?
prop_firm_faq.myfundedfutures_q_gap_17_answer: You cannot decline: MFFU's FAQ says rejecting the move to a Live Funded Account is not possible. On Rapid plans, $10,000 net profit in one trading day triggers an automatic move, or the Risk Team can approve you on payout performance. Builder plans move after 5 consecutive payouts or reaching the $100K sim cap, and Pro plans are reviewed after 3 consecutive payouts or $20,000 profit. Your sim funded accounts are merged into one Live account, and Live costs such as CME professional data, commissions and platform fees come out of the Live balance.

prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_163_a: Know Your Trader (KYT) is a short, AI-conducted interview, separate from KYC identity checks, that confirms "the person trading the account is the person who holds it." Under its KYT policy, Tradeify may require it before funding, before a payout or after a review, and says being asked "is not an accusation of wrongdoing." Questions come from your own trading history, it usually takes under 10 minutes, and a Tradeify team member reviews every interview. You must answer yourself, without other people or AI tools. Missing the deadline can pause account activity, payouts or access.

prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_164_a: You cannot log in through a VPN or VPS. Tradeify's Common FAQs say "After logging in normally, you may use VPS for trading at your own risk." A shared household, network or device is not, by itself, a violation, according to its Risk & Compliance FAQ. Tradeify does use device, network and session data, and a review may follow when access looks designed to conceal ownership, operate others' accounts or evade limits, "including through prohibited virtualization, remote-access, anonymization, or circumvention technologies." No single device or IP decides the outcome on its own.
prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_165_q: Can I be long on one Tradeify account and short on another, or long ES and short NQ?
prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_165_a: No. Tradeify's hedging rule bans opposing positions "on the same instrument or on two products from the same Product Group," in one account or spread across your accounts. Long ES on one account and short NQ on another is a violation because both are Equity Index products, and contract size does not matter: long MES against short NQ is still a hedge. Opposite directions across different groups, such as long ES and short CL, are allowed. Every account involved can be set to violation status with profits forfeited, and deliberate or repeated cases can bring a permanent ban.
prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_166_q: I hedged for a few seconds by accident on Tradeify. Will my account be breached?
prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_166_a: Not automatically, if you close it quickly. Tradeify's automated hedging check breaches an account only when all three conditions hold: opposing positions exist, "The hedge duration exceeds 10 seconds," and profit from the hedge exceeds $150. Tradeify says the 10-second window lets a trader who opens an opposing position by mistake close it without penalty, and it "is not an allowance to hold a hedge briefly on purpose." Cross-account and correlated-product hedges are reviewed separately by the risk team. If a platform error caused it, contact support immediately.
prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_167_q: Is copy trading allowed at Tradeify, and can I use a third-party copier?
prop_firm_faq.tradeify_faq_167_a: Yes, between accounts you own. Tradeify's Tradovate copy-trading guide says "You may only group trade between accounts you own and manage," and copying other people's strategies or copy trading with others is not permitted. Third-party trade copiers are allowed "at your own risk," and Tradeify does not support errors they cause. Copies must stay in the same direction: long ES on two of your accounts is fine, but opposite sides is a hedging violation. You can hold up to 5 funded accounts per household.

prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_cat_drawdown_title: What Are Take Profit Trader's Profit Target and Trailing Drawdown Rules?
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_1_question: What is the profit target on TPT 25?

prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_3_question: What are the profit targets for TPT 75, 100, 150?

The percentage is constant; the dollar amount scales linearly with account size. This makes the relative difficulty identical regardless of size - only your contract sizing changes.
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_4_question: What is trailing drawdown at TPT?
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_4_answer: Trailing drawdown is a moving floor that tracks your highest balance, less the size-specific drawdown amount. On the Test phase it locks end-of-day (only the daily close updates the floor). On PRO it locks intraday - each new unrealized peak instantly tightens the floor. PRO+ goes back to an EOD-locked drawdown with no $0 buffer. Drop below the floor at any point and the account fails immediately.
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_5_question: What is the exact trailing drawdown for each TPT size?
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_5_answer: TPT 25 = $1,500. TPT 50 = $2,000. TPT 75 = $2,500. TPT 100 = $3,000. TPT 150 = $4,500. These are dollar amounts, not percentages - your drawdown buffer is fixed in cash regardless of how much your account swings. Smaller accounts have proportionally tighter risk.
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_6_question: When does the TPT trailing drawdown lock?
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_6_answer: On the Test phase the trailing drawdown locks at $0 (the starting balance) once your floor catches up. After that, the drawdown stops trailing higher and becomes a static "no-loss" floor at starting balance. On PRO the drawdown trails intraday (no lock at $0). On PRO+ the drawdown is end-of-day and does not include the $0 buffer - once you breach the floor, the account ends.
prop_firm_faq.take_profit_trader_q_drawdown_7_question: Does the trailing drawdown trail intraday or end-of-day?
